title: Open-Faced Whole Grain Bagel with Avocado, Smoked Salmon, and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["75 g Bagel, whole wheat", "50 g Avocado, raw", "75 g Salmon, smoked", "1 piece Egg, raw, poached (50 g)", "15 g Cream cheese, plain", "5 g Red onion, raw, sliced", "10 g Tomato, raw, sliced", "5 g Capers", "2 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "5 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: Toast the whole wheat bagel halves until golden and crisp on a toaster or in a toaster oven for 2-3 minutes. Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of black pepper, then spread evenly on the toasted bagel halves. Layer on thin slices of smoked salmon, followed by slices of red onion and tomato. Poach the egg by bringing a small pot of water to a gentle simmer, adding a splash of vinegar, creating a vortex with a spoon, and carefully sliding in the egg; cook for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but yolk is runny, then drain on a paper towel. Top each bagel half with half the poached egg, a dollop of cream cheese, capers, and chopped dill. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Whole Grain Bagels with Avocado, Smoked Salmon, and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["120 g Bagel, whole wheat", "100 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Salmon, smoked", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "20 g Cream cheese, plain", "15 g Onion, red, raw", "5 g Capers", "10 g Lemon juice", "2 g Dill, fresh", "50 ml Water, for poaching"]
instructions: Toast the whole wheat bagel halves in a toaster or under a medium grill until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of black pepper, then spread evenly on the toasted bagel halves. Layer smoked salmon, thinly sliced red onion, capers, and chopped fresh dill on top of the avocado. Bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer over medium heat, crack the egg into a ramekin, and gently slide it into the simmering water. Poach the egg for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but the yolk is still runny, then remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel. Place the poached egg on top of the toppings, add a dollop of cream cheese on the side, and serve immediately while warm.

title: Whole Grain Bagel with Avocado, Smoked Salmon and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["100 g Bagel, whole wheat", "100 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Salmon, smoked", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "10 g Cream cheese, plain", "5 g Lemon juice", "2 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "1 g Salt", "50 ml Water"]
instructions: Slice the whole wheat bagel in half and lightly toast both halves in a toaster or under a medium grill until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, a pinch of salt, and chopped dill until smooth. Spread the mashed avocado evenly on both toasted bagel halves. Layer slices of smoked salmon on top of the avocado. Bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer, crack the egg into a small bowl, then slide it into the simmering water. Poach the egg for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but the yolk is still runny. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel. Place the poached egg on top of the salmon. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on the side if desired, season lightly with salt, and serve immediately while warm.

title: Toasted Whole Wheat Bagels with Avocado, Smoked Salmon and Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Bagel, whole wheat", "100 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Salmon, smoked", "2 pieces Egg, raw, medium", "15 g Cream cheese, plain", "10 g Onion, red, raw", "5 g Capers", "0.5 piece Lemon, raw", "5 g Dill, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Slice the bagels in half horizontally and toast them in a toaster or under a medium-hot grill until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes. Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt until smooth. Poach the eggs by bringing a small pot of water to a gentle simmer, crack each egg into a separate small bowl, then slide them into the water and cook for 3-4 minutes until the whites are set but yolks are still runny; remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Spread each toasted bagel half with a thin layer of cream cheese, then top the bottom halves with mashed avocado, followed by slices of smoked salmon, thin rings of red onion, a few capers, a poached egg, freshly chopped dill, black pepper, and a final squeeze of lemon juice. Place the top bagel halves on and serve immediately while warm.

title: Whole Grain Bagel with Avocado, Smoked Salmon, and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Bagel, whole wheat", "100 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Salmon, smoked", "2 pieces Egg, raw, medium", "15 g Cream cheese, plain", "50 g Tomato, raw, ripe", "10 g Onion, red, raw", "5 g Capers", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Dill, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Sea salt"]
instructions: Toast the two whole wheat bagels in a toaster or under a medium-hot grill until golden and crisp on both sides, about 2-3 minutes. Mash the avocado in a bowl with 5 ml lemon juice, a pinch of black pepper, and a pinch of sea salt until smooth. Poach the eggs in simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3-4 minutes until the whites are set but yolks are runny, then drain on paper towels. Spread each bagel half generously with cream cheese, top the bottom halves with sliced smoked salmon, poached eggs, mashed avocado, sliced tomatoes, thinly sliced red onion, capers, chopped dill, and a drizzle of remaining lemon juice. Season with a little sea salt and pepper, then place the top bagel halves on and serve immediately while warm.

title: Healthy Oat and Banana Breakfast Bread
ingredients_json: ["200 g Banana, raw, peeled", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "2 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "40 g Honey", "30 g Almonds, whole", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 20x10 cm loaf tin with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mash the bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, Greek yogurt, milk, and honey until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, then fold in the chopped almonds. Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice into portions to serve.

title: Healthy Banana Oat Bread with Walnuts and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g Banana, ripe, mashed", "200 g Flour, wheat, wholemeal", "150 g Oats, rolled", "2 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 g Honey", "50 g Walnuts, chopped", "30 g Olive oil", "5 g Baking powder", "3 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 22 cm loaf tin with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, honey, and olive oil until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, then stir in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve.

title: Healthy Oat and Banana Breakfast Bread
ingredients_json: ["200 g Banana, ripe, mashed", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "2 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 ml Vegetable oil", "50 g Honey", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Salt", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20x10 cm loaf tin with a little oil. In a large bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, Greek yogurt, vegetable oil, and honey until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Gradually stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix; the batter should be thick. Fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf tin and smooth the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the bread to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice into 8 portions and enjoy warm or at room temperature.

title: Healthy Banana Oat Bread with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g Bananas, raw, peeled", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "2 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "30 g Walnuts, raw", "20 g Rapeseed oil", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20x10 cm loaf tin with a little oil or line it with baking paper. In a large bowl, mash the peeled bananas with a fork until smooth. Add the eggs, Greek yogurt, honey, and rapeseed oil to the mashed bananas, and whisk together until well combined and smooth. In a separate bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Gradually stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Roughly chop the walnuts and fold them into the batter. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf tin and smooth the top with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the bread to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Healthy Oat and Almond Whole Wheat Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "50 g Almonds, ground", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Raisins"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. In a separate bowl, beat the butter with the honey until creamy, then add the egg and milk, mixing well. Gradually stir the wet ingredients into the dry mixture until a soft dough forms; fold in the raisins. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead for 1 minute, then pat it into a 2 cm thick round. Cut out biscuits using a 6 cm round cutter, re-patting scraps as needed to make 8 biscuits. Place them on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden and firm to the touch. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Oat and Almond Whole Wheat Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "50 g Almonds, ground", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "50 g Olive oil", "100 ml Almond milk, unsweetened", "50 g Apple, grated", "2 tbsp Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. In a separate bowl, mix together the olive oil, almond milk, grated apple, honey, and vanilla extract until well blended. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms; do not overmix. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 5 cm apart, and gently flatten each with the back of a spoon to about 1 cm thick. Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden and the biscuits are firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and allow them to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole Wheat Oat Biscuits with Seeds and Honey
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "50 g Sunflower seeds", "30 g Flaxseeds", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, salt, sunflower seeds, and flaxseeds. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. In a separate bowl, beat the egg with the milk and honey until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a fork until just combined into a soft dough, being careful not to overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, pat it into a 2 cm thick round, and cut out biscuits using a 6 cm round cutter. Place the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 5 cm apart. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the tops are golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Transfer to a wire rack to cool slightly before serving warm.

title: Whole Wheat Oat Biscuits with Seeds and Honey
ingredients_json: ["120 g Flour, wheat, wholemeal", "80 g Oats, rolled", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw, medium", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Sunflower seeds", "20 g Flaxseeds, whole"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt. Add the cold unsalted butter cut into small cubes, and rub it into the dry ingredients with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Stir in the sunflower seeds and flaxseeds. In a separate bowl, beat the egg with the honey and milk until well combined, then pour this into the dry mixture. Stir gently with a wooden spoon until a soft dough forms; do not overmix. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and pat it out to about 1.5 cm thick. Use a 6 cm round cutter to cut out biscuits, re-patting scraps as needed. Place the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet, leaving a little space between them. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown on top and firm to the touch. Transfer to a wire rack to cool slightly before serving warm.

title: Whole Wheat Oat Biscuits with Seeds and Honey
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "50 g Almonds, ground", "30 g Sunflower seeds", "30 g Flaxseeds", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, sunflower seeds, flaxseeds, baking powder, and salt. In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the butter with the honey until fully combined, then remove from heat. Beat the egg and milk together in a separate bowl, then stir in the melted butter-honey mixture. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms; do not overmix. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead for 30 seconds to bring it together. Roll out the dough to about 1 cm thickness and cut into 8-10 rounds using a 6 cm biscuit cutter. Place the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between them. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown on top and firm to the touch. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

title: Healthy Spinach and Cottage Cheese Blintzes
ingredients_json: ["120 g Wheat flour, white", "3 piece Egg, raw", "3 dl Milk, low fat", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "200 g Cottage cheese, low fat", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Garlic clove", "20 g Dill, fresh", "50 g Blueberries, raw", "20 g Honey", "5 g Salt"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, 2 eggs, milk, and 2 g salt until smooth to make the blintz batter. Let it rest for 15 minutes. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and melt a teaspoon of butter. Pour in 80 ml of batter, swirl to coat the pan thinly, and cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges lift and the bottom is golden. Flip and cook for 30 seconds more. Repeat with remaining batter, stacking the blintzes. For the filling, finely chop the spinach and dill, mince the garlic, and mix with cottage cheese, 1 egg, and 3 g salt. Spoon 2 tablespoons of filling onto each blintz, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a greased baking dish. Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes until heated through. Serve warm topped with blueberries and a drizzle of honey.

title: Healthy Buckwheat Blintzes with Spinach and Cottage Cheese Filling
ingredients_json: ["100 g Buckwheat flour", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 ml Water", "1 pinch Salt", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Onion", "10 ml Olive oil", "1 pinch Black pepper", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the buckwheat flour, semi-skimmed milk, 1 egg, water, and a pinch of salt until you have a smooth, thin batter with no lumps. Let it rest for 15 minutes at room temperature. Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and wilt the spinach in a hot non-stick pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until soft, then drain excess liquid and let cool. Mix the wilted spinach, cottage cheese, 1 egg, chopped onion, and black pepper in a bowl to form the filling. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat, lightly brush with olive oil, and pour in about 50 ml of batter, swirling to make a thin 20 cm crepe. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges lift and the bottom is golden, then flip and cook for 30 seconds more. Spoon 2 tablespoons of filling onto each blintz, fold the sides in and roll up tightly. Place seam-side down in a lightly oiled baking dish and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 10 minutes to set. Serve 2 blintzes per portion topped with 25 g Greek yogurt and 25 g blueberries.

title: Healthy Buckwheat Blintzes with Spinach and Cottage Cheese Filling
ingredients_json: ["100 g Buckwheat flour", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Garlic clove, raw", "5 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "5 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Blueberries, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the buckwheat flour, semi-skimmed milk, and egg until a smooth, thin batter forms with no lumps. Let the batter rest for 15 minutes at room temperature. Meanwhile, prepare the filling: blanch the fresh spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, drain, and chop finely. Mix the chopped spinach with low-fat cottage cheese, minced garlic clove, and chopped fresh dill in a bowl; season lightly with a pinch of salt and set aside. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease with a tiny dab of butter. Pour about 50 ml of batter into the pan, tilting it to spread thinly, and cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges lift and the bottom is golden. Flip carefully with a spatula and cook the other side for 30 seconds. Spread 1-2 tablespoons of filling on each blintz, roll up tightly, and keep warm. Repeat with remaining batter to make 4-6 blintzes. Serve warm topped with a dollop of plain low-fat yogurt and fresh blueberries.

title: Healthy Buckwheat Blintzes with Cottage Cheese and Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["100 g Buckwheat flour", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "50 g Ricotta cheese, low-fat", "1 tsp Honey", "100 g Mixed berries, frozen", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "50 ml Water"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the buckwheat flour, semi-skimmed milk, and egg until smooth to create a thin batter. Let it rest for 15 minutes. For the filling, mix the low-fat cottage cheese, low-fat ricotta cheese, and honey in a small bowl until creamy and set aside. In a small saucepan, combine the mixed berries, water, and lemon juice. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries break down into a thick compote. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease with a tiny dab of butter using a paper towel. Pour about 50 ml of batter into the pan, swirling to form a thin 20 cm crepe. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges lift and the bottom is golden. Flip and cook for another 30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter, greasing the pan lightly between each. Place 1-2 tablespoons of cheese filling in the center of each blintz, fold the sides in, then roll up tightly like a cigar. Melt the remaining butter in the pan over low heat. Arrange the blintzes seam-side down and cook for 2 minutes per side until golden and warmed through. Serve immediately topped with the berry compote.

title: Healthy Buckwheat Blintzes with Cottage Cheese and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["100 g Buckwheat flour", "200 ml Milk, skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "50 g Blueberries, raw", "10 g Honey", "5 g Olive oil", "1 g Salt", "2 g Baking powder"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the buckwheat flour, skimmed milk, egg, salt, and baking powder until a smooth batter forms. Let the batter rest for 15 minutes at room temperature. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly brush it with olive oil. Pour about 75 ml of batter into the pan, tilting it to spread evenly into a thin crepe. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges lift and the bottom is lightly golden, then flip and cook for another 30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter to make 4 blintzes. In a small bowl, mix the low-fat cottage cheese with chopped spinach and honey until well combined. Place a generous spoonful of the filling in the center of each blintze, fold the sides in and roll up tightly. Serve warm topped with fresh blueberries.

title: Healthy Veggie Breakfast Burritos with Scrambled Eggs and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Tortilla, wheat flour, soft", "4 pieces Egg, raw", "100 g Black beans, cooked", "100 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Tomato, ripe, red", "60 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "20 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "5 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Lime juice"]
instructions: Heat 5 g olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Chop the red bell pepper and tomato into small dice, and roughly chop the spinach. Add the diced bell pepper and tomato to the pan, sauté for 3 minutes until softened. Crack the 4 eggs into a bowl, whisk with 1 g salt and 1 g black pepper, then pour into the pan with the vegetables. Add the black beans and spinach, stirring gently for 2-3 minutes until the eggs are just set and fluffy, avoiding overcooking. Remove from heat. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds. Divide the egg mixture evenly among the 4 tortillas, top each with 15 g sliced avocado, 5 g grated cheddar cheese, and a squeeze of lime juice. Roll up tightly into burritos, folding in the sides first then rolling from the bottom. Serve immediately.

title: Veggie-Packed Spinach and Egg Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Tortilla, wheat flour, soft", "200 g Egg, raw, whole", "100 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Tomato, ripe, red", "80 g Avocado, raw", "60 g Black beans, cooked, canned, drained", "50 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "10 g Olive oil", "5 g Lime juice", "2 g Salt", "2 g Chili powder"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs with 1 g of salt and the chili powder until well combined. Chop the spinach roughly, dice the tomato into small cubes, and mash the avocado with the lime juice and remaining 1 g of salt until smooth. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat for 1 minute. Add the spinach and sauté for 2 minutes until wilted, then pour in the egg mixture. Cook gently, stirring occasionally with a spatula, for 3-4 minutes until the eggs are just set but still soft. Remove from heat. Warm the tortillas in a microwave for 20 seconds or on a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side. Spread one-quarter of the avocado mixture on each tortilla, top with one-quarter of the egg-spinach mixture, black beans, diced tomato, and shredded cheddar cheese. Fold the bottom of the tortilla up, then fold in the sides and roll tightly to enclose the filling. Serve immediately.

title: Veggie-Packed Breakfast Burritos with Scrambled Eggs and Black Beans
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Tortilla, wheat flour, soft", "4 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "100 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw, chopped", "80 g Spinach, raw, chopped", "80 g Avocado, raw, sliced", "60 g Cheddar cheese, mild, grated", "20 g Onion, red, raw, finely chopped", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Chili powder", "2 g Cumin, ground"]
instructions: Heat 15 ml olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add 20 g finely chopped red onion and 100 g chopped red bell pepper, and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in 80 g chopped spinach, 100 g cooked black beans, 2 g chili powder, 2 g cumin, and 5 g salt, cooking for another 2 minutes until the spinach wilts and everything is well combined. Crack 4 eggs into a bowl, whisk lightly with a fork, then pour into the skillet. Gently scramble the eggs with the vegetables over medium-low heat for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until just set but still creamy. Remove from heat. Warm the 4 wheat tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds or in a dry skillet. Divide the egg mixture evenly among the tortillas, top each with 20 g grated cheddar cheese and 20 g sliced avocado. Fold the bottom of each tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll tightly to enclose. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Veggie-Packed Turkey Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Tortilla, wheat flour, soft", "200 g Turkey breast, lean, cooked", "4 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "100 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "50 g Onion, raw", "100 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "10 g Olive oil", "5 g Salsa, mild"]
instructions: Chop the onion, bell pepper, and spinach into small pieces. Heat 10 g olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped vegetables and sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened and fragrant, stirring occasionally. Dice the cooked turkey breast into small cubes and add to the skillet, cooking for another 2 minutes to heat through. In a bowl, whisk the 4 eggs until well beaten, then pour over the vegetable and turkey mixture. Stir gently with a spatula, cooking for 3-4 minutes until the eggs are set but still moist, forming soft scrambles. Remove from heat. Warm the 4 tortillas in a microwave for 20 seconds or on a dry skillet. Divide the egg mixture evenly among the tortillas, topping each with 25 g sliced avocado, 20 g shredded cheddar cheese, and a teaspoon of salsa. Fold the bottom of each tortilla up, then fold in the sides and roll tightly to enclose the filling. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Veggie-Packed Spinach and Black Bean Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Egg, raw", "100 g Black beans, cooked", "100 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Tomato, ripe, red", "50 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Cheddar cheese, mild", "4 pieces Wheat tortilla, medium", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Cumin, ground"]
instructions: Heat 15 ml olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add 100 g chopped spinach and sauté for 2 minutes until wilted, then stir in 100 g drained black beans, 5 g cumin, 5 g salt, and 2 g black pepper, cooking for 1 minute to combine flavors. Crack 4 eggs into the skillet, scramble gently with a spatula for 3-4 minutes until just set but still moist. Remove from heat and stir in 80 g diced tomato and 50 g diced avocado. Warm 4 wheat tortillas in a microwave for 20 seconds or on a dry skillet. Divide the egg mixture evenly among the tortillas, top each with 25 g shredded cheddar cheese, then roll tightly into burritos, folding in the sides first. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Spinach and Egg Breakfast Casserole with Whole Grain Toast
ingredients_json: ["300 g Spinach, raw", "8 piece Egg, raw", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "150 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "100 g Onion, raw", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "100 g Whole grain bread, sliced", "50 g Cheese, cheddar, reduced fat", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "10 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Heat 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 100 g chopped onion and 100 g diced red bell pepper, sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened. Stir in 300 g fresh spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted, then season with 5 g salt and 2 g black pepper. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together 8 eggs, 200 ml semi-skimmed milk, and 150 g cottage cheese until smooth. Cut 100 g whole grain bread into 2 cm cubes and fold into the egg mixture along with the vegetable mixture and 50 g grated reduced-fat cheddar cheese. Pour everything into a greased 20x30 cm baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set when tested with a knife. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before slicing into portions.

title: Vegetable and Egg Breakfast Casserole with Spinach and Peppers
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "200 ml Milk, low fat", "200 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "100 g Tomato, raw", "150 g Cheese, cheddar, reduced fat", "100 g Whole wheat bread", "5 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease a 20x30 cm baking dish with the olive oil. Chop the onion, bell pepper, and tomato into small pieces. Wilt the spinach in a pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, then drain excess water. Cube the whole wheat bread into 2 cm pieces. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper until smooth. Stir in the chopped vegetables, bread cubes, and 100 g of the grated cheese. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and sprinkle the remaining 50 g cheese on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, until the top is golden and the center is set when tested with a knife. Let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Egg Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["300 g Spinach, raw", "200 g Mushrooms, white, raw, sliced", "1 small Onion, raw, finely chopped", "6 piece Egg, raw, whole", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "150 g Cheese, cheddar, reduced fat, grated", "100 g Whole wheat bread, sliced", "10 ml Olive oil", "3 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and lightly grease a 20x30 cm baking dish with a bit of olive oil. Heat 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and sliced mushrooms, cooking for 5-7 minutes until softened and the liquid has evaporated, stirring occasionally. Add the spinach and cook for another 2-3 minutes until wilted, then season with 3 g salt and 2 g black pepper. Remove from heat and spread evenly in the prepared baking dish. Cut the whole wheat bread into 2 cm cubes and scatter them over the vegetables. In a bowl, whisk together the 6 eggs and 200 ml milk until well combined, then pour evenly over the bread and vegetables. Sprinkle the grated cheese on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set when gently pressed. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing into portions.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Feta Egg Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, raw", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "200 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "100 g Cheese, feta", "100 g Whole wheat bread, average", "1 piece Onion, raw", "5 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Chop the onion and slice the mushrooms. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion for 3 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until they release their liquid and soften. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Cut the whole wheat bread into 2 cm cubes. In a greased 20x30 cm baking dish, layer the bread cubes, vegetable mixture, and crumble the feta cheese evenly over the top. Pour the egg mixture over everything, ensuring it soaks in evenly. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set when gently pressed. Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Egg Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["300 g Spinach, raw", "200 g Tomatoes, ripe, raw", "150 g Feta cheese, from cow's milk", "8 piece Egg, raw, whole", "200 ml Milk, 1.5% fat", "100 g Whole wheat bread, sliced", "1 piece Onion, raw", "20 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Chop the onion finely and sauté it in 20 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the 300 g spinach and cook until wilted, stirring frequently, for another 3-4 minutes. Dice the 200 g tomatoes and crumble the 150 g feta cheese. Cut the 100 g whole wheat bread into 2 cm cubes. In a large bowl, whisk together the 8 eggs, 200 ml milk, 5 g salt, and 2 g black pepper until well combined. Grease a 2-liter baking dish with a little olive oil. Spread the bread cubes evenly in the dish, then layer the sautéed spinach and onion mixture over the bread. Scatter the diced tomatoes and crumbled feta on top. Pour the egg mixture evenly over everything, pressing down gently to ensure the bread is soaked. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set when gently pressed. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before slicing into portions.

title: Herbed Oven-Roasted Breakfast Potatoes with Bell Peppers and Onions
ingredients_json: ["600 g Potatoes, boiled, cooked without salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Red bell pepper, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Rosemary, dried", "1 tsp Paprika powder, smoked", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Dice the cooked potatoes into 2 cm cubes and chop the red bell pepper and onion into similar-sized pieces. Mince the garlic cloves. In a large bowl, toss the potato cubes, bell pepper, onion, and garlic with the olive oil, dried rosemary, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated. Spread the mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy on the edges and the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized. Remove from the oven and serve hot.

title: Herbed Breakfast Potatoes with Bell Peppers and Onions
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potatoes, boiled, peeled", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, raw, chopped", "1 medium Red bell pepper, raw, diced", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tsp Paprika powder, smoked", "0.5 tsp Dried thyme", "0.25 tsp Salt, table", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Dice the boiled and peeled potatoes into 1 cm cubes. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and diced red bell pepper, and sauté for 4-5 minutes until they begin to soften and the onion turns translucent. Stir in the minced garlic, smoked paprika, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and spread them out evenly. Cook undisturbed for 5 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy, then flip the potatoes with a spatula and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until all sides are crispy and tender. Remove from heat, stir in the chopped fresh parsley, and serve immediately while hot.

title: Herbed Breakfast Potatoes with Bell Peppers and Onions
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potatoes, raw, peeled", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, raw, chopped (100 g)", "1 medium Red bell pepper, raw, diced (100 g)", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tsp Paprika powder", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Wash, peel, and cut the potatoes into 1.5 cm cubes. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the potato cubes in a single layer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown and soften. Add the chopped onion, diced red bell pepper, and minced garlic to the skillet. Season with paprika, thyme, rosemary, salt, and black pepper. Stir everything together and cook for another 10-12 minutes over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy on the outside and tender inside. Check doneness by piercing a potato cube with a fork; it should be soft. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Herbed Breakfast Potatoes with Bell Peppers and Onions
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potatoes, boiled, peeled", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, chopped", "1 piece Bell pepper, red, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tsp Paprika, smoked", "0.5 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Dice the boiled and peeled potatoes into 1 cm cubes. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and red bell pepper, and sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in the minced garlic, smoked paprika, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, cooking for 1 minute until aromatic. Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and spread them out evenly. Cook undisturbed for 5 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy, then flip the potatoes using a spatula and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until all sides are crispy and tender. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot.

title: Herbed Breakfast Potatoes with Bell Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potatoes, boiled, without salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "100 g Spinach, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Paprika powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Peel and dice the boiled potatoes into 1 cm cubes. Finely chop the onion, dice the red bell pepper into small pieces, mince the garlic, and roughly chop the spinach. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and diced bell pepper, and sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in the minced garlic, paprika powder, salt, and black pepper, cooking for 1 minute until aromatic. Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and spread them out evenly. Cook undisturbed for 5 minutes until the bottom is golden and crispy, then flip the potatoes with a spatula and cook for another 5 minutes until crispy on all sides. Stir in the chopped spinach and cook for 2 more minutes until wilted. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot.

title: Healthy Oat and Almond Flour Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g Oats, rolled, ground fine", "50 g Almond flour", "7 g Dry yeast", "200 ml Milk, skimmed", "50 g Apple sauce, unsweetened", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Salt", "15 g Cinnamon, ground", "30 g Coconut sugar", "20 g Raisins, seedless", "50 g Greek yogurt, low-fat"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, ground oats, almond flour, dry yeast, and salt. Warm the skimmed milk to about 37°C and stir it into the dry ingredients along with the apple sauce and egg to form a soft dough. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size. Punch down the dough, roll it out into a 40x30 cm rectangle on a floured surface. Mix the cinnamon with coconut sugar and sprinkle evenly over the dough, then scatter the raisins on top. Roll up the dough tightly from the long side into a log and cut into 8 equal rolls. Place the rolls in a greased baking dish, cover, and let rise for another 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 180°C. Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes until golden and they sound hollow when tapped. Mix the Greek yogurt with a little water to make a thin glaze and drizzle over the warm rolls before serving.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Apple Filling
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "5 g Dry yeast", "150 ml Skimmed milk", "1 piece Egg, raw", "20 g Rapeseed oil", "2 g Salt", "30 g Honey", "100 g Apple, raw, with skin, grated", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "15 g Raisins, seedless", "80 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "10 g Honey"]
instructions: Warm the skimmed milk to about 37°C in a small saucepan over low heat. In a large mixing bowl, combine the dry yeast, whole wheat flour, salt, and 30 g honey. Add the warm milk, egg, and rapeseed oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a soft dough forms. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the bowl with a clean kitchen towel and let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it doubles in size. Grate the apple and squeeze out excess moisture, then mix it with cinnamon and raisins to make the filling. Punch down the risen dough, roll it out into a 40x30 cm rectangle on a floured surface. Spread the apple filling evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 cm border on one long edge. Roll the dough tightly from the long side into a log, then slice into 8 equal rolls. Place the rolls cut-side up in a greased 20x20 cm baking dish, cover, and let rise for another 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Mix the Greek yogurt with 10 g honey to make a glaze and drizzle over the warm rolls before serving.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Oats and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["200 ml Milk, skimmed", "7 g Yeast, baker's, fresh", "250 g Flour, wheat, wholemeal", "50 g Oats, rolled", "20 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "3 g Salt", "10 g Olive oil", "100 g Apple, raw, with skin, grated", "10 g Cinnamon, ground", "30 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Cream cheese, light", "20 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "10 g Honey"]
instructions: Warm the milk to about 37°C in a saucepan over low heat, then dissolve the yeast in it. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, 20 g honey, egg, salt, and olive oil. Add the yeast-milk mixture and the grated apple, then knead for 8-10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size. Chop the almonds finely. Punch down the dough, roll it out on a lightly floured surface into a 40x30 cm rectangle. Sprinkle the cinnamon and chopped almonds evenly over the dough, then roll it up tightly from the long side into a log. Cut the log into 8 equal pieces. Place the rolls cut-side up in a greased baking dish, cover, and let them rise for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 180°C. Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and they sound hollow when tapped. For the icing, mix the light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, and 10 g honey until smooth, then drizzle over the warm rolls.

title: Healthy Oat Flour Cinnamon Rolls with Apple Filling
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour", "200 g Oat flour", "7 g Dry yeast", "200 ml Almond milk, unsweetened", "50 g Apple sauce, unsweetened", "30 g Coconut oil, melted", "5 g Cinnamon powder", "20 g Erythritol sweetener", "1 g Salt", "150 g Apple, grated", "5 g Cinnamon powder", "50 g Walnuts, chopped", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "20 g Honey", "2 g Vanilla extract"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, oat flour, dry yeast, and salt. Warm the almond milk to about 40°C and stir in the melted coconut oil and apple sauce. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and knead for 8-10 minutes until a smooth, elastic dough forms. Cover the bowl with a clean kitchen towel and let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until it doubles in size. In a small bowl, mix the grated apple, 5 g cinnamon powder, chopped walnuts, and 10 g erythritol to make the filling. Punch down the risen dough, roll it out on a lightly floured surface into a 40x30 cm rectangle, and spread the filling evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 cm border on one long edge. Roll the dough tightly from the long edge into a log and cut into 8 equal slices. Place the slices cut-side up in a greased baking dish, cover, and let rise for another 30 minutes. Preheat your oven to 180°C. Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and firm to the touch. While baking, whisk together the Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, and remaining 10 g erythritol for the glaze. Drizzle the glaze over the warm rolls and serve immediately.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Oats and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "7 g Yeast, dry, active", "200 ml Milk, skimmed", "50 g Apple sauce, unsweetened", "1 g Salt", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "30 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "20 g Raisins", "20 g Honey", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 g Oats, rolled", "10 g Honey"]
instructions: Warm the skimmed milk to about 37°C in a small saucepan over low heat, then dissolve the yeast in it and let it sit for 5 minutes until foamy. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, 100 g rolled oats, salt, 1 tsp cinnamon, and the yeast mixture along with the apple sauce and honey. Mix until a soft dough forms, then knead on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough with a clean kitchen towel and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in size. Meanwhile, finely chop the almonds and mix them with the raisins and a pinch of cinnamon for the filling. Preheat your oven to 180°C. Punch down the risen dough and roll it out on a floured surface into a 40x30 cm rectangle. Spread the almond-raisin mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 cm border. Roll the dough tightly from the long side into a log, then slice into 8 equal rolls. Place the rolls cut-side up in a greased baking dish, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until golden brown. For the glaze, blend the Greek yogurt with 50 g rolled oats and 10 g honey until smooth, then drizzle over the warm rolls before serving.

title: Healthy Banana Oat Coffee Cake with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["200 g Oats, rolled, dry", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "2 piece Egg, raw", "200 g Banana, raw, peeled", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 ml Milk, skimmed", "50 g Honey", "50 g Walnuts, raw", "2 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Raisins, seedless"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20x20 cm baking dish with a little oil. In a food processor, blend the oats until they resemble a fine flour, then transfer to a large mixing bowl and stir in the whole wheat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon. In a separate bowl, mash the bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and vanilla extract until well combined. Chop the walnuts roughly and fold them into the wet mixture along with the raisins. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, stirring gently until just combined—do not overmix. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top is golden. Allow to cool in the dish for 10 minutes before slicing into 8 squares.

title: Healthy Oat and Banana Coffee Cake with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["200 g Oats, rolled, dry", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "2 piece Egg, raw", "200 g Banana, raw, peeled", "150 ml Milk, low-fat, 1.5% fat", "80 ml Rapeseed oil", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 g Honey", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt, table", "100 g Walnuts, shelled", "100 g Blueberries, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20x20 cm baking tin with a little rapeseed oil. In a large bowl, mash the bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, Greek yogurt, honey, and rapeseed oil until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Gradually stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Fold in 75 g of the chopped walnuts and the blueberries gently. Pour the batter into the prepared tin and sprinkle the remaining 25 g walnuts on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden. Allow the cake to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice into squares for serving.

title: Healthy Banana Oat Coffee Cake with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["200 g Banana, ripe, mashed", "150 g Oats, rolled, uncooked", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almonds, ground", "2 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "30 g Walnuts, chopped", "5 g Baking powder", "3 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Salt", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed"]

Slice into 9 equal squares for serving.

title: Healthy Whole Grain Cornbread with Yogurt and Honey
ingredients_json: ["200 g Cornmeal, yellow, whole grain", "150 g Flour, wheat, whole grain", "15 g Baking powder", "5 g Salt", "5 g Baking soda", "300 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 ml Milk, low fat, 1%", "1 piece Egg, raw", "30 g Honey", "30 ml Rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and lightly grease an 20x20 cm baking dish with a bit of oil. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, whole grain flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda until evenly combined. In a separate bowl, beat the egg, then stir in the yogurt, milk, honey, and rapeseed oil until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a spatula just until combined, avoiding overmixing to keep the texture light. The batter should be thick but pourable. title: Healthy Spinach and Cottage Cheese Danishes
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "10 g Yeast, baker's, fresh", "150 ml Milk, skimmed", "50 g Apple sauce, unsweetened", "5 g Salt, table", "200 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Onion, raw", "20 g Sunflower seeds"]
instructions: Start by activating the yeast in the warm skimmed milk, about 37°C, for 10 minutes until frothy. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, salt, apple sauce, and the yeast mixture to form a soft dough. Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 200°C. Chop the spinach and onion finely, then sauté the onion in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until soft, add spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted; let cool and mix with cottage cheese, egg, and sunflower seeds for the filling. Punch down the dough, divide into 6 equal portions, roll each into a 15 cm circle on a floured surface. Place 2 tablespoons of filling in the center of each, fold edges towards center to partially enclose, leaving some filling visible. title: Healthy Spinach and Cottage Cheese Danish Pastries
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "7 g Dry yeast", "150 ml Skimmed milk", "50 g Margarine, 60% fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Salt", "200 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Onion, raw", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]

Punch down the dough, divide into 6 equal pieces, and roll each into a 15 cm circle. title: Healthy Spinach and Cottage Cheese Protein Danishes
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "150 g Low-fat quark", "100 ml Water, cold", "50 g Spinach, fresh, chopped", "100 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "30 g Rolled oats", "5 g Honey", "20 g Almonds, chopped"]

title: Healthy Apple and Almond Whole Wheat Danishes
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "10 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "150 g Apple, raw, with skin", "20 g Honey", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "50 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "20 g Almonds, flaked"]

title: Baked Oat Flour Doughnuts with Cinnamon and Apple
ingredients_json: ["200 g Oat flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "1 piece Egg, raw", "150 ml Milk, low-fat", "50 g Apple puree", "30 g Honey", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt", "50 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "10 g Flaxseeds, whole"]

title: Baked Oatmeal Banana Doughnuts with Cinnamon and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["150 g Banana, ripe, mashed", "100 g Oats, rolled, uncooked", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, low-fat, plain", "30 g Honey", "5 g Baking powder", "3 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Salt", "30 g Almonds, whole, blanched, chopped", "10 g Coconut oil, melted"]

title: Baked Oatmeal Banana Doughnuts
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oat flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 piece Banana, ripe, mashed (about 120 g)", "1 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Blueberries, fresh"]

title: Baked Oatmeal Protein Doughnuts with Cinnamon and Banana

title: Baked Oatmeal Banana Doughnuts with Cinnamon and Nuts
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oats, rolled, dry", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "1 piece Banana, raw, peeled", "1 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "30 g Almonds, whole, raw", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Salt", "10 g Sunflower oil"]

title: Avocado and Smoked Salmon English Muffins with Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces English muffins, whole wheat", "200 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Salmon, smoked", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "20 g Rocket salad", "10 g Lemon juice", "5 g Olive oil", "1 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Avocado and Smoked Salmon English Muffins with Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces English muffins, whole wheat", "100 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Salmon, smoked", "2 pieces Egg, raw, medium", "15 g Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Chives, fresh, chopped", "5 g Olive oil", "1 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Healthy Whole Grain French Toast with Banana and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["60 g Bread, wholemeal, average", "1 piece Egg, raw, chicken", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "50 g Banana, raw", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "10 ml Rapeseed oil", "20 g Blueberries, raw"]
instructions: In a shallow bowl, whisk together the egg, milk, and ground cinnamon until well combined. Slice the banana and mash half of it into the egg mixture for added flavor and creaminess, then slice the remaining half for topping. Cut the wholemeal bread into two thick slices. Heat the rapeseed oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, ensuring both sides are fully coated and soaked for about 10-20 seconds. Place the soaked bread in the hot pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy on the edges, pressing gently with a spatula for even cooking. Transfer to a plate, top with the sliced banana and blueberries, and serve immediately while warm.

title: Healthy Whole Grain French Toast with Berries and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["60 g Bread, whole wheat, sliced", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw, medium", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "5 ml Olive oil", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 g Strawberries, raw", "20 g Blueberries, raw", "10 g Honey"]

Add the soaked bread slices and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy on the edges, pressing lightly with a spatula for even cooking. title: Healthy Whole Grain French Toast with Berries and Cinnamon

title: Healthy Whole Grain French Toast with Banana and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["60 g Bread, whole wheat, sliced", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw, medium", "1 piece Banana, raw, medium", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "20 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "10 g Honey, raw"]

title: Healthy Whole Grain French Toast with Berries and Almonds

Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides generously but not soaking too long to avoid sogginess, about 10-15 seconds per side. title: Spinach and Feta Vegetable Frittata
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Tomato, raw", "50 g Onion, raw", "50 g Cheese, feta", "5 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick ovenproof frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened and translucent, stirring occasionally. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted, then add the diced tomato and cook for another 1 minute. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Pour the egg mixture into the pan over the vegetables. Crumble the feta cheese evenly over the top. Cook on the stovetop over low-medium heat for 4-5 minutes until the edges are set but the center is still slightly runny. Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the frittata is fully set and puffed up, and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from the oven and let it rest for 2 minutes before slicing.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Veggie Frittata
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Cheese, feta", "50 g Onion, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Spinach and Feta Vegetable Frittata

title: Spinach and Feta Vegetable Frittata

title: Spinach and Mushroom Protein Frittata

title: Healthy Honey Nut Granola with Oats and Seeds
ingredients_json: ["300 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, whole", "50 g Pumpkin seeds", "50 g Sunflower seeds", "50 g Chia seeds", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt", "80 g Honey", "60 ml Olive oil", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "80 g Dried apricots, chopped"]

title: Healthy Spinach and Egg Breakfast Kolaches
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "5 g Active dry yeast", "120 ml Skim milk", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "20 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "100 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "1 g Black pepper", "20 g Feta cheese, reduced-fat"]

ingredients_json: ["15 ml olive oil", "150 g onion, chopped", "100 g celery, chopped", "100 g green bell pepper, chopped", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "200 g diced tomatoes, canned, no salt added", "250 ml vegetable broth, low sodium", "300 g shrimp, peeled and deveined", "150 g okra, sliced", "5 g whole wheat flour", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g paprika", "1 g cayenne pepper", "2 g sea salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "200 g brown rice, cooked"]

title: Healthy Chicken Fajitas with Peppers and Whole Wheat Tortillas
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken breast fillet, raw, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Red bell pepper, raw", "1 medium Yellow bell pepper, raw", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika powder", "0.5 tsp Chilli powder", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "1 juice Lime, raw", "8 pieces Whole wheat tortilla, medium", "200 g Avocado, raw", "200 g Tomatoes, raw", "100 g Plain yogurt, low-fat", "20 g Fresh coriander leaves"]

ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "200 g Red bell pepper, raw", "200 g Yellow bell pepper, raw", "200 g Onion, raw", "150 g Whole wheat tortilla", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Chili powder", "3 g Ground cumin", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Paprika powder", "5 ml Lime juice", "3 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Crispy Chickpea Falafel with Quinoa Tabbouleh and Tahini Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chickpeas, dry, cooked", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "15 g Coriander leaves, fresh", "1 tsp Cumin seeds, ground", "1 tsp Coriander seeds, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "2 tbsp Chickpea flour", "100 ml Vegetable oil, rapeseed", "100 g Bulgur, dry", "200 g Tomato, raw", "100 g Cucumber, raw", "20 g Mint leaves, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Tahini paste", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "100 ml Water", "0.25 tsp Salt, table"]
instructions: First, prepare the falafel mixture by draining the cooked chickpeas and patting them dry with a paper towel. In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped parsley, chopped coriander leaves, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and lemon juice. Pulse until the mixture comes together but retains some texture, about 30-40 seconds. Add the chickpea flour and pulse briefly to incorporate. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes to firm up. While chilling, cook the bulgur by bringing 250 ml water to a boil, adding the bulgur, reducing heat to low, covering, and simmering for 12 minutes until tender and water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and let cool. Dice the tomatoes and cucumber, finely chop the mint leaves, and toss with the cooled bulgur, olive oil, and a pinch of salt to make the tabbouleh. For the tahini sauce, whisk together the tahini paste, lemon juice, water, and salt in a small bowl until smooth and creamy; set aside. Form the falafel mixture into 12 golf-ball-sized balls, then flatten slightly into patties. Heat the rapeseed oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat to 180°C. Fry the falafels in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy, turning once. Drain on paper towels. Serve the hot falafels with the tabbouleh and tahini sauce drizzled over top.

title: Baked Chickpea Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Sauce and Veggie Salad
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chickpeas, cooked, drained", "1 piece Onion, raw, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "15 g Coriander leaves, fresh", "1 tsp Cumin seeds, ground", "1 tsp Coriander seeds, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "20 g Chickpea flour", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Cucumber, raw", "100 g Tomato, raw", "50 g Red onion, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "20 g Tahini paste", "100 g Lettuce, iceberg", "150 g Bulgur, dry", "300 ml Water"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, combine the cooked chickpeas, chopped onion, garlic cloves, parsley, coriander leaves, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and lemon juice. Pulse until the mixture is coarsely chopped and holds together when pressed, but not completely smooth. Add the chickpea flour and pulse briefly to incorporate. Form the mixture into 12 small balls, about 3 cm in diameter, and flatten slightly into patties. Brush the falafel patties lightly with olive oil and arrange them on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and crispy on the outside. While the falafel bakes, cook the bulgur by bringing 300 ml water to a boil in a saucepan, add the dry bulgur, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 12 minutes until tender and water is absorbed, then fluff with a fork and set aside. For the tahini yogurt sauce, whisk together the plain yogurt, tahini paste, and a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy. Prepare the veggie salad by thinly slicing the cucumber, tomato, red onion, and tearing the lettuce into bite-sized pieces; toss them together in a bowl. To serve, divide the cooked bulgur, fresh salad, and baked falafel among plates, and drizzle the tahini yogurt sauce over the top.

title: Baked Chickpea Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Sauce and Veggie Salad
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chickpeas, cooked and drained", "1 piece Onion, raw, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "15 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "15 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp Cumin seeds, ground", "1 tsp Coriander seeds, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "1 tsp Lemon juice, raw", "20 g Chickpea flour", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "15 g Tahini paste", "100 g Cucumber, raw, diced", "100 g Tomato, raw, diced", "50 g Lettuce, iceberg, shredded", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Whole wheat pita bread"]

title: Crispy Baked Chickpea Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Sauce and Veggie Salad
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chickpeas, cooked, drained", "1 piece Onion, raw, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "30 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "20 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Ground coriander", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "30 g Chickpea flour", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Cucumber, raw, sliced", "100 g Tomatoes, raw, chopped", "50 g Red onion, raw, sliced", "150 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tbsp Tahini paste", "1 tsp Lemon juice, fresh"]

title: Fettuccini with Grilled Chicken, Spinach, and Lemon Cream Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Fettuccini, dry", "250 g Chicken breast fillet, without skin", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "1 dl Cream, 15% fat", "1 dl Milk, 1.5% fat", "1 piece Lemon, juice and zest", "2 cloves Garlic", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add the fettuccini and cook for 10-12 minutes until al dente, stirring occasionally. Drain the pasta, reserving 1 dl of the cooking water, and set aside. Meanwhile, season the chicken breasts with 2 g salt and 1 g black pepper. Heat 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 6-7 minutes per side until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 75°C. Remove from the skillet, let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly. In the same skillet, add the remaining 5 ml olive oil over medium heat. Mince the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Stir in the cream, milk, lemon juice, lemon zest, and reserved pasta water. Simmer for 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the cooked fettuccini, sliced chicken, and grated Parmesan to the skillet. Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes over low heat until well coated and heated through. Season with the remaining 3 g salt and 1 g black pepper. Serve immediately with extra Parmesan if desired.

title: Fettuccini with Grilled Chicken, Spinach and Lemon Garlic Sauce

title: Fettuccini with Grilled Salmon, Spinach and Lemon Cream Sauce

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g Beef, tenderloin steak, lean, raw", "200 g Asparagus, green, raw", "150 g Quinoa, dry", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "15 g Lemon juice", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then place it in a saucepan with 300 ml of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a low simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is fluffy. Remove from heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200°C. Trim the woody ends off the asparagus, toss with 1/2 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, a pinch of salt, and pepper, and spread on a baking sheet. Heat the remaining 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until smoking hot. Add the steaks and sear for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare (internal temperature 60°C). title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Garlic Mashed Sweet Potatoes

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["400 g Beef, tenderloin, lean only, raw", "300 g Potatoes, boiled, peeled", "200 g Asparagus, green, raw", "100 g Milk, 1.5% fat", "20 g Butter, salted", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Fresh thyme leaves"]

title: Mediterranean Veggie and Hummus Flatbreads

title: Healthy Teriyaki Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Vegetables

title: Creamy Mushroom Soup with Thyme and Garlic
ingredients_json: ["500 g Mushrooms, white button, raw", "200 g Onions, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "40 g Flour, wheat, plain", "7 dl Vegetable broth", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "50 g Creme fraiche"]
instructions: Clean the mushrooms by wiping them with a damp cloth and slice them thinly. Finely chop the onions and mince the garlic cloves. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and garlic, and sauté for about 4-5 minutes until softened and fragrant, stirring occasionally. Add the sliced mushrooms and dried thyme, and cook for another 7-8 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown. Sprinkle the flour over the mushroom mixture and stir well for 1-2 minutes to cook out the raw flour taste. Gradually pour in the vegetable broth and milk while stirring constantly to avoid lumps, then bring the soup to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the soup thickens slightly and the flavors meld. Stir in the creme fraiche, salt, and black pepper, and heat through for 2 more minutes without boiling. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before blending until smooth using an immersion blender or in batches in a regular blender. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before serving hot.

title: Creamy Mushroom and Vegetable Soup with Herbs
ingredients_json: ["500 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "200 g Carrots, raw", "150 g Onions, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "100 ml Cream, 15% fat", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme leaves", "1 tbsp Cornstarch", "200 ml Water", "20 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Clean the mushrooms by wiping them with a damp cloth and slice them thinly. Peel and finely chop the carrots, onions, and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and garlic, and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add the sliced mushrooms and carrots, stirring occasionally, and cook for 8-10 minutes until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Mix the cornstarch with 200 ml cold water to make a smooth slurry, then stir it into the soup. Add the cream and fresh thyme, and simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the soup thickens slightly. Remove from heat, stir in chopped parsley, and season with black pepper if desired. Serve hot with crusty bread.

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Nachos with Black Beans and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["200 g Tortilla chips, baked, low fat", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, cooked", "150 g Black beans, canned, drained", "100 g Tomato, fresh, chopped", "80 g Avocado, fresh, sliced", "50 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated", "50 g Greek yogurt, low fat, plain", "30 g Red onion, finely chopped", "15 g Jalapeño pepper, fresh, sliced", "15 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped", "5 ml Lime juice, fresh", "5 g Chili powder", "3 g Cumin, ground", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Shred the cooked chicken breast into small pieces and mix it in a bowl with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and 1 g of salt. Spread the baked tortilla chips evenly in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Top the chips evenly with the seasoned chicken, drained black beans, chopped tomato, finely chopped red onion, sliced jalapeño, and grated reduced-fat cheddar cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly. Remove from the oven and let cool for 2 minutes. Dollop the Greek yogurt over the nachos, add the sliced avocado, drizzle with fresh lime juice, and sprinkle with chopped coriander leaves and the remaining 1 g of salt. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Baked Black Bean Chicken Nachos with Veggies
ingredients_json: ["200 g Tortilla chips, corn, baked", "150 g Chicken breast, grilled, skinless", "200 g Black beans, cooked, canned, drained", "100 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Tomatoes, cherry, raw", "50 g Red onion, raw", "50 g Sweetcorn, kernels, canned, drained", "100 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "50 g Jalapeño peppers, raw, sliced", "20 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped", "15 ml Lime juice, raw", "5 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Spread the tortilla chips evenly in a large baking dish. Shred the grilled chicken breast and scatter it over the chips along with the drained black beans, chopped cherry tomatoes, diced red onion, drained sweetcorn, and sliced jalapeños. Drizzle the olive oil over the top and squeeze the lime juice evenly across the mixture. Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese generously over everything. Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly with golden spots. Remove from the oven, garnish with chopped fresh coriander leaves, and serve immediately while hot.

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Nachos with Black Beans and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["200 g Tortilla chips, baked, low-fat", "150 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, cooked", "100 g Black beans, canned, drained", "50 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "100 g Tomato, fresh, diced", "50 g Red onion, finely chopped", "1 piece Avocado, ripe, diced (about 100 g)", "30 g Jalapeño pepper, fresh, sliced", "15 g Fresh coriander, chopped", "100 g Plain yogurt, low-fat", "5 ml Lime juice, fresh", "5 g Taco seasoning mix"]

title: Baked Veggie Chicken Nachos with Black Beans
ingredients_json: ["200 g Tortilla chips, baked, plain", "150 g Chicken breast fillet, cooked, skinless", "100 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "80 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "100 g Avocado, ripe, diced", "100 g Tomatoes, cherry, chopped", "50 g Red onion, finely chopped", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "15 g Jalapeño peppers, fresh, sliced", "30 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped", "5 ml Lime juice, fresh", "5 g Chili powder", "3 g Cumin powder", "2 g Garlic powder"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Spread the tortilla chips evenly in a large baking dish. Shred the cooked chicken breast and sprinkle it over the chips along with the black beans. Scatter the chopped cherry tomatoes, red onion, and jalapeño slices on top. Evenly distribute the grated cheddar cheese over everything. Dollop the Greek yogurt over the nachos, add the diced avocado and chopped coriander, then drizzle with fresh lime juice. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Nachos with Black Beans and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["200 g Tortilla chips, baked, low-fat", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, cooked", "150 g Black beans, canned, drained", "100 g Tomatoes, fresh, chopped", "80 g Red bell pepper, chopped", "50 g Red onion, finely chopped", "100 g Avocado, fresh, diced", "80 g Cheddar cheese, low-fat, grated", "100 g Plain yogurt, low-fat", "15 g Lime juice, fresh", "5 g Fresh cilantro, chopped", "2 g Chili powder", "2 g Ground cumin", "1 g Garlic powder", "2 g Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. In a small bowl, mix the chili powder, ground cumin, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt with the olive oil to make a spice rub. Shred the cooked chicken breast and toss it with the spice rub until evenly coated. Spread the baked tortilla chips in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Top the chips evenly with the spiced chicken, drained black beans, chopped tomatoes, chopped red bell pepper, and finely chopped red onion. Sprinkle the grated low-fat cheddar cheese over the top. While baking, mix the plain low-fat yogurt with fresh lime juice and chopped fresh cilantro to make a creamy sauce. Remove the nachos from the oven and let them cool for 2 minutes.
