title: Healthy Tuna and Vegetable Whole Wheat Noodle Casserole
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat pasta, dry", "200 g Tuna in water, drained", "200 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "150 g Carrots, sliced", "200 g Low-fat cottage cheese", "200 ml Semi-skimmed milk", "100 g Tomatoes, chopped", "50 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "1 tsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Spinach, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Cook the whole wheat pasta in a large pot of boiling water according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside. In a steamer or saucepan, steam the broccoli florets and sliced carrots for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp, then set aside. In a large skillet, heat 1 tsp olive oil over medium heat, add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, dried oregano, black pepper, and fresh spinach, cooking for 2-3 minutes until the spinach wilts. In a blender or bowl, mix the low-fat cottage cheese and semi-skimmed milk until smooth to create a creamy sauce. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, steamed vegetables, flaked tuna, and the tomato-spinach mixture. Pour the cheese sauce over everything and stir well to coat evenly. Transfer the mixture to a greased 2-liter baking dish, sprinkle the whole wheat breadcrumbs evenly on top, and bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the top is golden and the casserole is bubbling hot. Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey and Spinach Whole Wheat Noodle Casserole
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat egg noodles, dry", "400 g Turkey breast fillet, raw, diced", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "200 g Tomatoes, chopped", "1 dl Low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "100 g Low-fat cottage cheese", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Dried oregano"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Cook the whole wheat egg noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside. In a skillet over medium heat, heat the olive oil and sauté the diced turkey breast with minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and dried oregano for 6-8 minutes until the turkey is browned and cooked through. Add the fresh spinach and chopped tomatoes, stirring for 2-3 minutes until the spinach wilts. In a bowl, whisk together the low-fat milk, low-fat cottage cheese, and egg until smooth. In a large baking dish, combine the cooked noodles, turkey-vegetable mixture, and milk-cheese mixture, stirring to distribute evenly. Sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the top is golden and bubbly. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Whole Wheat Noodle Bake
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat noodles, dry", "300 g Turkey breast fillet, raw", "200 g Broccoli florets, raw", "150 g Carrots, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw (100 g)", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "50 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "10 g Whole wheat flour", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Cook the whole wheat noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Chop the onion, carrots, broccoli, and garlic finely. Add the turkey breast, cut into bite-sized pieces, to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until browned. Add the chopped vegetables and garlic, season with 3 g salt and 1 g black pepper, and sauté for another 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the canned tomatoes and simmer for 3 minutes. In a small saucepan, heat the remaining 5 ml olive oil over medium heat, whisk in the whole wheat flour, and cook for 1 minute to make a roux. Gradually pour in the milk while whisking constantly, bring to a simmer, and cook for 2-3 minutes until thickened. Stir in the cottage cheese and season with the remaining salt and pepper. Combine the cooked noodles, turkey-vegetable mixture, and cheese sauce in a large bowl, then transfer to a greased 2.5-liter baking dish. Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the top is golden and bubbly. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Veggie-Packed Turkey and Whole Wheat Noodle Casserole
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat noodles, dry", "300 g Turkey breast fillet, skinless, raw", "200 g Broccoli florets, raw", "150 g Carrots, raw, peeled", "150 g Zucchini, raw", "200 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "200 ml Low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "100 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "30 g Whole wheat flour", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Dried oregano"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Cook the whole wheat noodles in a large pot of boiling water according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Dice the turkey breast into bite-sized pieces and add to the skillet along with the minced garlic. Cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the turkey is browned and cooked through. Slice the carrots and zucchini into thin half-moons, chop the broccoli into small florets, and add all vegetables to the skillet. Sauté for 5 minutes until slightly softened. Stir in the canned tomatoes, oregano, salt, and black pepper, and simmer for 3 minutes. In a separate saucepan over medium heat, whisk together the whole wheat flour and low-fat milk to make a smooth sauce, stirring constantly for 4-5 minutes until thickened. Mix the drained noodles, turkey-vegetable mixture, and milk sauce in a large bowl until well combined. Transfer everything to a greased 2.5-liter baking dish, sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese evenly on top, and bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly with golden spots. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow it to set.

title: Healthy Tuna and Vegetable Whole Wheat Noodle Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat pasta, dry", "300 g Broccoli, raw, chopped", "200 g Carrots, raw, sliced", "150 g Sweetcorn, kernels, canned, drained", "200 g Tuna in water, canned, drained", "400 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated", "1 tsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "100 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the whole wheat pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside. Meanwhile, steam the chopped broccoli and sliced carrots for 5 minutes until just tender, then mix with the drained sweetcorn and flaked tuna in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, warm the olive oil and sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the whole wheat flour and cook for 1 minute to make a roux, then gradually whisk in the milk, cooking and stirring constantly until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes. Add the Dijon mustard and 75 g of the grated cheddar cheese, stirring until melted and smooth. Combine the sauce with the pasta, tuna, and vegetables, then transfer everything to a greased 2.5-liter baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining 25 g cheese and breadcrumbs evenly over the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling. Remove from the oven and let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Chicken Pad Thai with Veggies and Peanuts
ingredients_json: ["150 g Rice noodles, dry", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, raw, skinless", "100 g Tofu, firm", "1 piece Egg, raw, whole", "100 g Bean sprouts, fresh", "80 g Carrot, raw, peeled", "50 g Spring onions, fresh", "30 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted", "15 ml Lime juice, fresh", "20 g Palm sugar or brown sugar", "20 ml Fish sauce", "10 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "5 ml Chili sauce, sweet", "20 ml Peanut oil", "5 g Garlic, fresh, minced", "10 g Coriander leaves, fresh", "5 g Ginger root, fresh, grated"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and cube the tofu. Julienne the carrot and chop the spring onions into 3 cm pieces. In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, palm sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and chili sauce to make the sauce; set aside. Heat 10 ml peanut oil in a large wok over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned, then push to one side. Add the egg to the empty side, scramble for 1 minute until just set, then mix with chicken. Add remaining 10 ml peanut oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the tofu, carrots, and 2/3 of the spring onions; stir-fry for 2 minutes. Toss in the drained noodles, bean sprouts, and the prepared sauce. Stir-fry everything together for 3-4 minutes, tossing frequently until noodles are tender and coated evenly, and vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove from heat, sprinkle with peanuts, remaining spring onions, and coriander leaves. Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.

title: Healthy Chicken Pad Thai with Veggies and Peanuts
ingredients_json: ["150 g Rice noodles, dry", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, raw, skinless", "100 g Tofu, firm", "1 tbsp Vegetable oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, chopped", "1 piece Shallot, raw, sliced", "100 g Bean sprouts, raw", "50 g Carrot, raw, julienned", "1 piece Egg, raw, whole", "30 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted", "20 ml Lime juice, raw", "15 ml Fish sauce", "15 g Palm sugar or brown sugar", "10 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "5 g Chili flakes, dried"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped garlic and sliced shallot, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the diced chicken breast and firm tofu cubes, cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Push the mixture to one side of the wok, crack the egg into the empty side, scramble it for 1 minute until just set, then mix everything together. Add the soaked noodles, bean sprouts, and julienned carrot, stir-fry for 3 minutes. In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, soy sauce, and chili flakes until the sugar dissolves, then pour over the noodle mixture and toss well for 2 minutes until everything is coated and heated through. Remove from heat, sprinkle with roasted peanuts, and serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.

title: Healthy Chicken Pad Thai with Veggies
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dry", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "200 g Tofu, firm", "150 g Bean sprouts, raw", "100 g Carrots, raw, shredded", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "50 g Spring onions, raw", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "20 ml Lime juice, raw", "15 g Palm sugar or brown sugar", "20 ml Fish sauce", "15 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "5 g Garlic, raw, minced", "10 ml Peanut oil", "10 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted", "5 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and the tofu into small cubes. Shred the carrots and slice the red bell pepper into thin strips. Chop the spring onions and mince the garlic. In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, palm sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce to make the sauce. Heat the peanut oil in a large wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. Push the chicken to one side, add the tofu cubes, and stir-fry for 2 minutes until golden. Add the minced garlic and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Crack the eggs into the wok, scramble them quickly for 1 minute, then mix everything together. Add the soaked noodles, prepared vegetables (bean sprouts, carrots, bell pepper), and the sauce. Toss everything together over high heat for 3-4 minutes until the noodles are tender and well coated. Stir in most of the spring onions and peanuts, reserving some for garnish. Remove from heat, squeeze extra lime if desired, and garnish with remaining peanuts, spring onions, and coriander leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Chicken Vegetable Pad Thai
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dry", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "200 g Tofu, firm", "150 g Bean sprouts, fresh", "100 g Carrot, raw, grated", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "50 g Spring onions, raw", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "20 ml Vegetable oil", "2 tbsp Lime juice, fresh", "2 tbsp Fish sauce", "1 tbsp Tamari soy sauce, low sodium", "10 g Palm sugar", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "20 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted", "10 g Coriander leaves, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and the tofu into small cubes. Grate the carrot and slice the red bell pepper into thin strips. Chop the spring onions and mince the garlic. In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, fish sauce, tamari soy sauce, and palm sugar until the sugar dissolves. Heat 10 ml vegetable oil in a large wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove the chicken and set aside. Add another 5 ml oil to the wok, then add the tofu cubes and stir-fry for 2 minutes until golden. Push the tofu to one side, add the beaten eggs to the other side, and scramble for 1 minute until just set. Add the garlic, carrot, bell pepper, and spring onions, stir-frying for 2 minutes. Return the chicken to the wok, add the drained noodles, bean sprouts, and the sauce mixture. Toss everything together over high heat for 2-3 minutes until well combined and heated through. Remove from heat, sprinkle with chopped peanuts and coriander. Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.

title: Healthy Chicken Pad Thai with Veggies and Peanuts
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dry", "300 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "200 g Tofu, firm", "150 g Bean sprouts, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "50 g Spring onions, raw", "3 pieces Eggs, raw, medium", "30 g Peanuts, roasted", "20 ml Sesame oil", "20 ml Fish sauce", "15 g Palm sugar", "20 ml Lime juice, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Fresh coriander leaves", "1 tsp Chili flakes, dried"]
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and cut the tofu into 1 cm cubes. Julienne the carrot and slice the red bell pepper into thin strips, chop the spring onions, and roughly chop the peanuts and coriander. Heat 10 ml sesame oil in a large wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. Push the chicken to one side, add the remaining 10 ml sesame oil, and crack the eggs into the wok, scrambling them for 1-2 minutes until set, then mix with the chicken. Add the minced garlic and chili flakes, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Toss in the tofu, carrot, bell pepper, and drained noodles, stir-frying for 3 minutes. Pour in the fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar, tossing everything together for another 2 minutes until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is well coated. Add the bean sprouts and spring onions, stir for 1 minute until slightly wilted. Remove from heat, sprinkle with chopped peanuts and coriander, and serve immediately while hot.

title: Healthy Seafood Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["300 g Brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Green bell pepper, raw", "200 g Tomatoes, raw", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, without skin, raw", "150 g Shrimp, cooked", "150 g Mussels, cooked", "200 g Green beans, raw", "1 g Saffron", "5 g Smoked paprika powder", "1 l Vegetable broth", "1 piece Lemon, for zest and juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add the diced red and green bell peppers, chopped tomatoes, and green beans, and cook for another 5 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the brown rice, smoked paprika, and saffron, coating the rice evenly, and toast for 2 minutes. Add the diced chicken breast and cook for 5 minutes until it starts to brown on all sides. Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cover and cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and most liquid is absorbed. In the last 5 minutes, nestle the shrimp and mussels into the rice, cover again, and let them heat through. Remove from heat, zest and squeeze the lemon over the paella, fluff with a fork, and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Seafood Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["300 g Rice, brown, uncooked", "1000 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "200 g Shrimp, cooked, peeled", "150 g Mussels, cooked, shelled", "100 g Chicken breast, skinless, diced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw, sliced", "150 g Tomatoes, ripe, chopped", "100 g Green beans, cooked", "1 tsp Saffron threads", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "50 g Peas, green, frozen", "1 piece Lemon, juiced"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, sautéing for 3-4 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in the diced chicken breast and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned on all sides. Add the sliced red bell pepper, chopped tomatoes, green beans, and peas, cooking for another 4 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Sprinkle in the smoked paprika and saffron threads, stirring for 1 minute to release the aromas. Add the brown rice, stirring well to coat it with the oil and spices for 2 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and lemon juice, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid. In the last 5 minutes of cooking, nestle the shrimp and mussels into the rice, cover again, and allow them to heat through. Remove from heat and let it rest covered for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.

title: Healthy Seafood Vegetable Paella with Saffron and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["300 g Brown rice, dry", "1 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "200 g Shrimp, cooked, peeled", "200 g Mussels, cooked, shelled", "150 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, diced", "1 piece Onion, raw, finely chopped", "1 piece Red bell pepper, chopped", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh, minced", "100 g Green beans, fresh, trimmed", "100 g Tomatoes, fresh, diced", "1 tsp Saffron threads", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Smoked paprika powder", "0.5 tsp Turmeric powder", "1 piece Lemon, juice and zest", "20 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in the diced chicken breast and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned on all sides. Add the chopped red and yellow bell peppers, green beans, and diced tomatoes, cooking for another 4 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Sprinkle in the smoked paprika and turmeric, stirring for 1 minute to release the aromas. Add the brown rice and saffron threads, stirring well to coat the rice for 2 minutes. Nestle the shrimp and mussels into the rice, cover again, and cook for an additional 10-12 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed; check that the mussels and shrimp are heated through. Remove from heat, drizzle with lemon juice and zest, scatter with chopped parsley, and let it rest covered for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Seafood Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["300 g Rice, brown, cooked", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "150 g Shrimp, peeled, raw", "100 g Mussels, raw, shelled", "100 g Squid rings, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium (100g)", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw (100g)", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Tomatoes, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp Paprika, sweet", "0.5 tsp Saffron threads", "750 ml Vegetable broth, low-sodium", "150 g Green beans, fresh", "100 g Peas, frozen", "1 piece Lemon, juice (30ml)"]

title: Healthy Veggie-Packed Turkey Carbonara

title: Mediterranean Whole Wheat Pasta Salad with Grilled Chicken and Vegetables

title: Lean Beef and Root Vegetable Pasties
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Wholemeal spelt flour", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "1 piece Egg, raw", "80 ml Water, cold", "1 pinch Salt, table", "300 g Beef, lean, minced", "150 g Potato, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Swede, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "1 tsp Thyme, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]

title: Lean Beef and Root Vegetable Pasties

title: Baked Spinach and Mushroom Pierogies with Yogurt Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Wheat flour, white, all-purpose", "1 piece Egg, raw", "100 ml Water, tap", "1 g Salt, table", "150 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "50 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "20 g Dill, fresh", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 clove Garlic, raw"]

title: Baked Spinach and Cottage Cheese Pierogies with Tomato Sauce

title: Baked Spinach and Mushroom Pierogies with Yogurt Dill Sauce

title: Baked Spinach and Cottage Cheese Pierogies with Mushroom Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Wheat flour, white, all-purpose", "100 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "100 g Spinach, raw, chopped", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Salt", "50 ml Water, tap", "200 g Mushrooms, white button, sliced", "1 dl Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 clove Garlic, raw, minced", "10 g Olive oil", "20 g Whole wheat flour", "200 ml Vegetable broth, low-sodium"]

title: Baked Spinach and Mushroom Pierogies with Yogurt Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Wheat flour, white", "150 ml Water", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Salt", "200 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "100 g Cottage cheese, low-fat", "20 g Olive oil", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "10 g Dill, fresh", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Veggie Whole Wheat Pizza with Grilled Chicken and Fresh Herbs
ingredients_json: ["300 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "200 ml Water, tap", "10 g Yeast, baker's", "5 g Salt, table", "10 ml Olive oil", "100 g Tomato puree", "2 g Oregano, dried", "2 g Basil, dried", "150 g Chicken fillet, without skin, grilled", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, light", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Zucchini, raw", "50 g Mushrooms, raw", "50 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "20 g Onions, red, raw"]

title: Veggie Whole Wheat Pizza with Tomato Sauce and Mozzarella

title: Herbed Polenta with Grilled Vegetables and Tomato Sauce

title: Herbed Polenta with Grilled Vegetables and Chickpeas

title: Grilled Vegetable Polenta with Tomato Basil Sauce

title: Herbed Polenta with Grilled Vegetables and Feta

title: Baked Salmon with Quinoa, Asparagus and Lemon-Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g Salmon fillet, raw, Atlantic", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "300 g Asparagus, green, raw", "1 dl Lemon juice, fresh", "2 tbsp Dill, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]

title: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon with Quinoa and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["600 g Salmon fillet, raw, Atlantic", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "300 g Asparagus, green, raw", "1 dl Olive oil", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "20 g Fresh dill, chopped", "10 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "200 ml Water"]

title: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon with Quinoa and Steamed Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["400 g Salmon fillet, raw, without skin", "100 g Quinoa, dry", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "1 piece Lemon, juice and zest", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh", "5 g Fresh dill, chopped", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon with Quinoa and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["400 g Salmon fillet, raw, Atlantic", "150 g Quinoa, dry", "300 g Asparagus, green, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Lemon, raw, juice and zest", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "15 g Fresh dill, chopped", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon with Quinoa and Steamed Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["500 g Salmon fillet, raw, without skin", "150 g Quinoa, dry", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Lemon, juice and zest", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh", "10 g Fresh dill", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "200 ml Water"]

title: Grilled Chicken Avocado Club Sandwiches
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless", "4 slices Whole wheat bread, average", "80 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Tomatoes, ripe, raw", "80 g Lettuce, iceberg", "40 g Cheese, cheddar, reduced fat", "20 g Mayonnaise, light", "10 g Dijon mustard", "5 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Season the chicken breast fillets with 1 g salt and 0.5 g black pepper. Heat 5 ml olive oil in a grill pan over medium-high heat. Mash the avocado with 10 g Dijon mustard, a pinch of salt, and 0.5 g black pepper. Toast the 4 slices of bread until golden. Spread 10 g light mayonnaise on two slices and the avocado mixture on the other two. Layer each sandwich with 150 g sliced grilled chicken, 50 g sliced tomatoes, 40 g lettuce, and 20 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese. Top with the remaining bread slices, cut in half diagonally, and secure with toothpicks if needed. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Chicken Avocado Club Sandwiches with Veggies
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Whole wheat bread, average", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, raw, skinless", "1 tsp Olive oil", "50 g Avocado, raw", "50 g Tomatoes, ripe, raw", "30 g Lettuce, iceberg, raw", "40 g Cheddar cheese, mild", "1 tsp Dijon mustard"]

Lightly toast the 4 slices of whole wheat bread until golden. Spread 0.5 tsp Dijon mustard on each slice. Layer on each of two sandwiches: sliced chicken (100g per sandwich), 25g sliced avocado, 25g sliced tomato, 15g lettuce, and 20g cheddar cheese. Top with the remaining bread slices. title: Grilled Turkey and Avocado Club Sandwiches with Veggie Slaw
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat bread, sliced", "200 g Turkey breast, cooked, sliced", "1 piece Avocado, raw, ripe", "100 g Iceberg lettuce, raw", "100 g Tomato, raw, ripe", "80 g Carrots, raw", "50 g Red cabbage, raw", "50 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "20 g Dijon mustard", "15 ml Lemon juice, raw", "5 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, shred the carrots and red cabbage finely using a grater or knife. Add the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, 1 g salt, and half the black pepper, then mix well to form a creamy slaw. Set aside in the fridge for 10 minutes to let flavors meld. Mash the avocado in a small bowl with the olive oil, remaining 1 g salt, and remaining black pepper until smooth. Preheat a grill pan or non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Spread the avocado mash evenly on one side of each bread slice. Layer the turkey slices, lettuce leaves, tomato slices, and a generous scoop of veggie slaw on 3 of the bread slices. Top with the remaining bread slices, avocado side down. Place the sandwiches on the hot grill pan and press down gently with a spatula. Grill for 3-4 minutes per side until the bread is golden brown and toasted with visible grill marks, and the filling is warmed through. Cut each sandwich in half diagonally and serve immediately.

title: Grilled Turkey and Avocado Club Sandwiches with Veggie Slaw
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Whole wheat bread, average", "150 g Turkey breast, smoked, lean", "1 piece Avocado, raw, average", "50 g Lettuce, iceberg, raw", "50 g Tomato, raw, ripe", "100 g Cucumber, raw, with peel", "50 g Red bell pepper, raw", "20 g Greek yogurt, plain, 10% fat", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 ml Olive oil", "2 g Lemon juice", "1 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 20 g Greek yogurt, 5 g Dijon mustard, 2 g lemon juice, 1 g salt, and 1 g black pepper to make a creamy dressing. Lightly brush one side of each bread slice with 5 ml olive oil. Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat. title: Grilled Turkey and Avocado Club Sandwiches with Veggie Slaw
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Whole wheat bread, sliced", "150 g Turkey breast, roasted, skinless", "1 piece Avocado, raw, Hass", "50 g Iceberg lettuce, raw", "50 g Tomato, raw, ripe", "50 g Cucumber, raw", "30 g Carrot, raw, peeled", "20 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 ml Lemon juice, raw", "2 g Olive oil"]
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, and lemon juice to make a creamy dressing. Mash the avocado with a fork, season lightly with salt if desired, and spread evenly over two slices of the whole wheat bread. Layer sliced turkey breast, iceberg lettuce leaves, tomato slices, and cucumber on top of the avocado. Spoon the veggie slaw over the fillings and drizzle with the remaining dressing. title: Grilled Turkey Sausages with Quinoa, Peppers and Kale
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey sausage, lean, raw", "150 g Quinoa, dry", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw, medium", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper, raw, medium", "200 g Kale, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "300 ml Water"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold running water for 1 minute, then place it in a saucepan with 300 ml of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a low simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is fluffy. Remove from heat and let it steam covered for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, wash the kale, remove tough stems, and chop the leaves into bite-sized pieces. Core and thinly slice the red and yellow bell peppers. Peel and mince the garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the turkey sausages and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally with tongs, until browned on all sides and the internal temperature reaches 75°C. Remove the sausages to a plate and cover to keep warm. In the same skillet, add the minced garlic and sliced peppers, sautéing for 3 minutes until softened. Add the chopped kale and cook for another 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently, until wilted and tender. Stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to taste. Slice the cooked sausages into rounds. Fluff the quinoa with a fork and divide it between 4 plates. Top with the sausage slices and the pepper-kale mixture. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Grilled Turkey Sausage with Quinoa, Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey sausage, lean, raw", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "1 piece Onion, red, raw", "200 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "200 g Bell pepper, yellow, raw", "150 g Spinach, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Paprika powder, smoked", "400 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water and drain it well. In a medium saucepan, bring the vegetable broth to a boil over high heat, then add the quinoa. Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet, add the remaining 5 ml olive oil, and place the turkey sausages in the pan. Cook the sausages over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are browned on all sides and reach an internal temperature of 75°C. Add the fresh spinach to the skillet, season everything with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika, and stir for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Slice the sausages into rounds, then gently fold them into the quinoa along with the vegetable mixture. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Turkey Sausage with Quinoa, Bell Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey sausage, lean, raw", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "1 piece Onion, red, raw", "2 pieces Bell pepper, red, raw", "200 g Spinach, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "250 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Lemon juice"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water and drain it well. Remove from heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, chop the onion, bell peppers into strips, mince the garlic, and rinse the spinach. Heat 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice. Slice the sausages and gently mix them with the quinoa and sautéed vegetables in the skillet. title: Grilled Turkey Sausage with Quinoa and Bell Pepper Medley
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey sausage, lean, raw", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "1 piece Onion, red, raw", "2 pieces Bell pepper, red, raw", "2 pieces Bell pepper, yellow, raw", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "30 g Parsley, fresh", "500 ml Water"]

Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat. Brush the turkey sausages lightly with 5 ml olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through with an internal temperature of 75°C. While sausages cook, heat the remaining 10 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Chop the onion, bell peppers, zucchini, and garlic. Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté for 3 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add the chopped bell peppers and zucchini, season with 5 g salt and 2 g black pepper, and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the cooked quinoa and chopped parsley, heating through for 2 minutes. Slice the grilled sausages and serve atop the quinoa-vegetable medley.

title: Seitan Steak with Garlic Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["250 g Vital wheat gluten flour", "50 g Nutritional yeast flakes", "15 g Onion powder", "10 g Garlic powder", "5 g Smoked paprika", "3 g Salt", "5 g Dried thyme", "250 ml Vegetable broth", "30 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml Olive oil", "200 g Broccoli florets, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Quinoa, dry", "500 ml Water"]

Knead the dough for 5 minutes until elastic, then shape into 4 flat steaks. Place the steaks in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 30 minutes until firm. Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa under cold water, then cook it in 300 ml of water in a saucepan over medium heat for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is fluffy. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 5 ml of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the seitan steaks and sear for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove the steaks and set aside. In the same skillet, add the broccoli florets and minced garlic, sauté for 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green. Season with a pinch of salt if needed. Serve each seitan steak with 75 g cooked quinoa and 50 g garlic broccoli.

title: Seitan Stir-Fry with Bell Peppers and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["250 g Vital wheat gluten flour", "5 g Nutritional yeast flakes", "5 g Garlic powder", "5 g Onion powder", "3 g Smoked paprika", "2 g Salt", "2 g Ground black pepper", "180 ml Vegetable broth", "15 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml Olive oil", "200 g Bell peppers, red, raw", "150 g Broccoli florets, raw", "1 piece Ginger root, fresh (10 g)", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "30 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the vital wheat gluten flour, nutritional yeast flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. In a separate bowl, mix the vegetable broth and 15 ml soy sauce. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until a dough forms. Knead the dough vigorously for 5 minutes on a clean surface until elastic and smooth. Let it rest for 10 minutes, then shape into a log and wrap tightly in cheesecloth or foil. Steam the seitan log over boiling water for 45 minutes until firm. Unwrap and slice into 1 cm thick strips. Heat olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add minced ginger, chopped garlic, sliced bell peppers, and broccoli florets. Stir-fry for 5 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the seitan strips and 30 ml soy sauce. Stir-fry for another 4-5 minutes, tossing frequently until the seitan is golden and coated with sauce. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Seitan Steak with Garlic Mashed Potatoes and Steamed Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["200 g Vital wheat gluten flour", "50 g Nutritional yeast flakes", "15 g Onion powder", "10 g Garlic powder", "5 g Smoked paprika powder", "5 g Salt", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "200 ml Vegetable broth", "50 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml Olive oil", "600 g Potatoes, boiled, peeled", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "5 g Garlic, fresh, minced", "400 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "10 ml Lemon juice"]

Steam the broccoli florets over boiling water for 5-7 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Drizzle with lemon juice. Serve each seitan steak with a portion of garlic mashed potatoes and steamed broccoli.

title: Baked Seitan Steak with Garlic Herb Marinade and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g Vital wheat gluten flour", "50 g Nutritional yeast flakes", "15 g Garlic powder", "10 g Onion powder", "10 g Smoked paprika powder", "5 g Dried thyme", "5 g Salt", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "250 ml Vegetable broth", "50 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "30 ml Olive oil", "400 g Carrots, raw", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "200 g Zucchini", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]

Spread them on another baking tray and roast alongside the seitan for the last 20 minutes. Check that the seitan is firm and the vegetables are tender with slightly caramelized edges before removing from the oven. Let the seitan rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the roasted vegetables.

title: Seitan Steak with Garlic Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["250 g Vital wheat gluten flour", "50 g Nutritional yeast", "15 g Garlic powder", "10 g Onion powder", "5 g Smoked paprika", "5 g Salt", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "200 ml Vegetable broth", "30 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml Olive oil", "400 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "3 cloves Garlic, fresh", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "500 ml Water"]

In a saucepan, bring 500 ml water to a boil, add quinoa, reduce to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed and quinoa is fluffy. Steam broccoli florets for 5 minutes until tender-crisp. Mince garlic cloves and sauté in 1 teaspoon olive oil over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant. Toss with steamed broccoli and season with a pinch of salt. Serve seitan steaks with quinoa and garlic broccoli.

title: Healthy Turkey Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Mash
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "200 g Carrots, raw", "150 g Onions, raw", "100 g Celery stalks, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Tinned tomatoes, chopped", "200 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "600 g Sweet potatoes, raw", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "200 g Frozen green peas", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt"]

While the potatoes cook, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onions, diced carrots, chopped celery, and minced garlic, and sauté for 5 minutes until softened. Add the turkey mince, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook for 8-10 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the chopped tinned tomatoes, vegetable stock, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the frozen peas and cook for another 2 minutes. Transfer the turkey mixture to a 2-litre baking dish. Mash the drained sweet potatoes with the milk and butter until smooth and creamy. Spread the mash evenly over the turkey filling, using a fork to create ridges. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the top is golden and bubbling. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Turkey and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "200 g Carrots, raw", "150 g Onions, raw", "150 g Peas, green, frozen", "150 g Sweetcorn kernels, canned, drained", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "10 g Tomato purée", "250 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "5 g Plain flour", "800 g Potatoes, raw", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Butter, salted", "2 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the turkey mixture, using a fork to create ridges on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the topping is golden and crisp. title: Healthy Turkey and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "200 g Carrots, raw, peeled and diced", "150 g Peas, frozen", "150 g Sweetcorn kernels, canned, drained", "1 piece Onion, raw, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "200 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "1 tbsp Tomato purée", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "800 g Potatoes, raw, peeled and chopped", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground", "50 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Heat the rapeseed oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add the turkey mince and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the diced carrots, peas, sweetcorn, tomato purée, dried thyme, vegetable stock, and a pinch of black pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened slightly. Transfer the mixture to a large baking dish. Meanwhile, place the chopped potatoes in a pot, cover with cold water, add a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, and cook for 15 minutes until tender. Drain the potatoes, return to the pot, add the milk and butter, and mash until smooth and creamy. Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the turkey mixture, then sprinkle the grated cheese on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the topping is golden and bubbling. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Southern Shrimp and Grits with Bell Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["200 g Shrimp, raw, peeled", "150 g Grits, dry, stone-ground", "500 ml Water", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Onion, raw, chopped", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw, sliced", "100 g Spinach, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Cayenne pepper", "1 tbsp Lemon juice", "20 g Cheddar cheese, low-fat, grated", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 500 ml water and 200 ml semi-skimmed milk to a boil over medium-high heat. Stir in 150 g dry grits, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and creamy. Season with 1 g salt and stir in 20 g grated low-fat cheddar cheese until melted. Keep warm. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 100 g chopped onion, 100 g sliced red bell pepper, and 2 minced garlic cloves. Sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in 100 g raw spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Season with 4 g salt, 2 g black pepper, and 1 tbsp lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Divide the grits into 4 bowls and top each with the shrimp mixture. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Healthy Lemon Garlic Shrimp Scampi with Whole Wheat Linguine and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "200 g Whole wheat linguine, dry", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil", "4 cloves Garlic, fresh, minced", "125 ml White wine, dry", "60 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "15 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "5 g Lemon zest", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "250 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add the whole wheat linguine and cook according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes. Heat 15 ml olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Return the shrimp to the skillet along with the cooked linguine, reserved pasta water, parsley, lemon zest, remaining salt, and black pepper. Toss everything together over low heat for 2 minutes until well coated and heated through. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Sesame Ginger Tofu Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["400 g Tofu, firm", "200 g Broccoli florets", "150 g Brown rice, dry", "1 medium Carrot (100 g), sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "15 g Fresh ginger, minced", "15 ml Soy sauce, reduced-sodium", "15 ml Sesame oil", "10 ml Vegetable oil", "30 g Spring onions, chopped", "10 g Sesame seeds"]

title: Baked Teriyaki Tofu with Quinoa and Stir-Fried Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Tofu, firm", "100 g Quinoa, dry", "200 g Broccoli, raw", "150 g Carrots, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 tsp Ginger root, fresh, grated", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Sesame seeds", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]

title: Spinach and Ricotta Tortellini with Grilled Chicken and Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Tortellini, fresh, spinach and ricotta filling", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, raw", "400 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "100 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "20 g Basil, fresh leaves", "15 ml Olive oil", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Healthy Berry Angel Food Cake
ingredients_json: ["200 g Egg white, raw", "250 g Wheat flour, white", "300 g Cane sugar", "2 g Cream of tartar", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "150 g Raspberries, raw", "150 g Strawberries, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C and ensure it is completely clean with no grease or oil residue. Gradually add the cane sugar, about 50 g at a time, beating well after each addition until the meringue is glossy and holds stiff peaks. Invert the pan immediately onto a bottle neck or cooling rack and let it cool completely upside down for at least 2 hours. Once cool, run a thin knife around the edges to release the cake. title: Healthy Almond Oat Biscotti with Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["200 g Oats, rolled, raw", "150 g Almonds, whole, raw", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Honey", "40 g Olive oil", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 tsp Orange zest", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Transfer to a large bowl and mix in the whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the egg, honey, olive oil, and finely grated orange zest until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture and stir until a dough forms; it should be slightly sticky but hold together. Divide the dough in half and shape each half into a log about 25 cm long and 4 cm wide on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes until lightly golden and firm. Place the slices cut-side down back on the baking sheet and bake for an additional 10 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crisp and golden. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

title: Healthy Spiced Oat Christmas Cookies with Almonds and Orange Zest

title: Apple and Berry Cobbler with Whole Wheat Topping

title: Apple and Blueberry Cobbler with Oats

title: Healthy Vanilla Crème Brûlée with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, 10% fat", "200 ml Cream, whipping, 35% fat", "4 piece Egg, yolk, raw", "40 g Honey", "2 g Vanilla extract, natural", "20 g Sugar, white, granulated"]

title: Healthy Coconut Milk Flan with Maple Syrup

title: Healthy Spiced Gingerbread Cookies with Whole Wheat
ingredients_json: ["200 g Flour, wheat, wholemeal", "100 g Flour, wheat, white", "80 g Honey", "50 g Cane sugar, raw", "50 g Butter, salted", "1 piece Egg, raw", "15 g Ginger, ground", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "3 g Cloves, ground", "3 g Baking soda", "2 g Salt", "40 ml Milk, low-fat"]
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the wholemeal flour, white flour, ground ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda, and salt. Stir well to distribute the spices evenly. In a separate bowl, beat the egg with the honey, cane sugar, softened butter, and milk until smooth and creamy. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry mixture, stirring until a firm dough forms. If the dough is too sticky, add a little more flour. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes until smooth. Wrap in plastic film and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to firm up. Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Roll out the dough to 4 mm thickness on a floured surface and cut into shapes using cookie cutters. Place the cookies 2 cm apart on the baking sheets. Bake for 8-10 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and firm. Allow to cool on the sheets for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Creamy Banana Yogurt Ice Cream with Berries
ingredients_json: ["300 g Banana, ripe, raw", "400 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 g Strawberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "50 g Honey", "1 tsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Peel the bananas and slice them into chunks. Place the banana chunks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and freeze for at least 2 hours until solid. Wash the strawberries and blueberries, pat them dry, and chop the strawberries into small pieces. In a food processor or high-speed blender, combine the frozen banana chunks, yogurt, honey, and lemon juice. Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed; this should take about 2-3 minutes. Add the chopped strawberries and blueberries, then pulse briefly 4-5 times to incorporate the berries without pureeing them completely. Transfer the mixture to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 2-3 hours until firm but scoopable. Let it soften at room temperature for 5-10 minutes before serving for the best texture.

title: Creamy Banana Mango Yogurt Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Banana, raw, peeled", "200 g Mango, raw, ripe", "400 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "30 g Honey"]
instructions: Peel and slice the bananas and mango into small chunks, then freeze them for at least 4 hours or overnight until solid. In a blender or food processor, combine the frozen banana and mango pieces with the plain yogurt, semi-skimmed milk, lemon juice, and honey. Blend on high speed until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed, which should take about 2-3 minutes. If the mixture is too thick, add a splash more milk to help it blend. Transfer the blended mixture to a loaf pan or airtight container and freeze for 2-3 hours, stirring every 30 minutes during the first 1.5 hours to prevent ice crystals from forming. Once firm but scoopable, serve the ice cream in bowls or cones. Store any leftovers in the freezer for up to one week.

title: Mango Banana Coconut Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Mango, raw, peeled", "250 g Banana, raw, peeled", "400 ml Coconut milk, light", "50 g Chia seeds", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "20 g Honey"]
instructions: Peel and chop the mango and bananas into small chunks, then freeze them for at least 4 hours or overnight until solid. In a blender, combine the frozen mango, frozen banana, coconut milk, chia seeds, lime juice, and honey. Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed, which should take about 2-3 minutes. If the mixture is too thick, add a splash of coconut milk to help blending. Once creamy, transfer to a loaf pan or airtight container, cover, and freeze for 2-3 hours until firm but scoopable. Let it soften slightly at room temperature for 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Banana Mango Yogurt Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Banana, ripe, raw", "200 g Mango, fresh, raw", "400 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "20 g Honey", "5 g Chia seeds"]
instructions: Peel and slice the bananas and mango into small chunks, then place them in a freezer-safe container and freeze for at least 4 hours until solid. Once frozen, add the frozen fruits, yogurt, milk, lemon juice, honey, and chia seeds to a high-speed blender or food processor. Blend on high speed for 2-3 minutes, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed, until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy like soft-serve ice cream. If it's too thick, add a splash more milk and blend again. Transfer the mixture to a loaf pan or airtight container, smooth the top, and freeze for 2-3 hours more until firm but scoopable. Let it sit at room temperature for 5-10 minutes before scooping to serve.

title: Creamy Banana Strawberry Yogurt Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["400 g Banana, raw, peeled", "300 g Strawberries, raw", "400 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 ml Milk, skimmed", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "20 g Honey"]
instructions: Peel the bananas and cut them into chunks. Hull the strawberries and cut them into halves. Place the bananas, strawberries, yogurt, milk, vanilla extract, and honey in a blender or food processor. Blend on high speed until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, about 2-3 minutes, scraping down the sides as needed. Pour the mixture into a shallow freezer-safe container, such as a loaf pan lined with parchment paper. Smooth the top with a spatula. Cover tightly with plastic wrap or a lid and freeze for 4-6 hours, stirring every hour for the first 3 hours to break up ice crystals and ensure a creamy texture. Once firm but scoopable, let it sit at room temperature for 5-10 minutes before serving to soften slightly.

title: Healthy Key Lime Pie with Almond Crust and Greek Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "30 g Coconut oil", "20 g Honey", "300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat, plain", "150 ml Lime juice, fresh", "80 g Honey", "20 g Lime zest", "15 g Gelatin powder, unflavored", "50 ml Water", "200 g Avocado, raw, flesh only"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C. Place the almonds in a food processor and pulse until finely ground. Melt the coconut oil and mix it with the ground almonds, 20 g honey, and a pinch of salt to form a crumbly dough. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 23 cm pie dish. Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly golden, then let it cool completely. In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 50 ml cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes. Gently heat the bloomed gelatin in a microwave for 10-15 seconds until dissolved, stirring to ensure it's smooth, then set aside. In a blender, combine the Greek yogurt, lime juice, 80 g honey, lime zest, and avocado flesh. Blend until creamy and smooth. Stir in the dissolved gelatin until fully incorporated. Pour the filling into the cooled crust and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until set. Garnish with additional lime zest or slices before serving.

title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oats, rolled", "30 g Almonds, whole", "20 g Coconut oil", "30 g Honey, blossom", "400 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "200 ml Lime juice, fresh", "100 g Honey, blossom", "20 g Cornflour, unmodified", "6 g Gelatin powder", "50 ml Water", "1 tsp Lime zest"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. In a food processor, pulse the oats and almonds until finely ground. Add the melted coconut oil and 30 g honey, and process until the mixture comes together like wet sand. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 23 cm pie dish. Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly golden, then let it cool completely. In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 50 ml water and let it bloom for 5 minutes. In a saucepan, whisk together the lime juice, 100 g honey, cornflour, and lime zest. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in the bloomed gelatin until fully dissolved, then let it cool for 10 minutes. Gently fold in the Greek yogurt until smooth and fully combined. Pour the filling into the cooled crust, smooth the top, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until set. Garnish with extra lime zest before serving.

title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["150 g Digestive biscuits, wholemeal", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "500 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "100 ml Lime juice, fresh", "80 g Honey", "20 g Lime zest", "15 g Gelatin powder", "50 ml Water"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Crush the digestive biscuits into fine crumbs using a food processor or by placing them in a sealed bag and smashing with a rolling pin. Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, then mix it with the biscuit crumbs until well combined. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom and sides of a 22 cm pie dish to form the crust. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes until lightly golden, then remove and let cool completely. In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin powder over 50 ml cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes. Gently heat the mixture in a microwave for 20-30 seconds until fully dissolved, stirring well; do not boil. In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, lime juice, honey, and lime zest until smooth and creamy. Gradually add the dissolved gelatin to the yogurt mixture, whisking continuously to incorporate evenly. Pour the filling into the cooled crust, smoothing the top with a spatula. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or until fully set and firm. Slice and serve chilled.

title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Almonds, whole", "40 g Coconut oil", "2 tbsp Honey, raw", "450 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 ml Lime juice, fresh", "80 g Honey, raw", "15 g Gelatin powder, unflavored", "50 ml Water, cold", "1 tsp Lime zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a food processor, pulse the rolled oats and whole almonds until they form a coarse crumb. Melt the coconut oil and mix it with 2 tablespoons of honey, then combine with the oat-almond mixture until it resembles wet sand. Press this mixture firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 23 cm pie dish. Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly golden, then remove and let it cool completely. To prepare the filling, sprinkle the gelatin powder over 50 ml cold water in a small bowl and let it bloom for 5 minutes. Gently heat the bloomed gelatin in a microwave for 10-15 seconds until fully dissolved, stirring to ensure it's smooth. In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, fresh lime juice, 80 g honey, and lime zest until creamy and well combined. Gradually stir in the dissolved gelatin until fully incorporated. Pour the filling into the cooled crust, spreading it evenly. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until set. Serve chilled, garnished with extra lime zest if desired.

title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Digestive biscuits, wholemeal", "80 g Butter, unsalted", "600 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 ml Lime juice, fresh", "80 g Honey", "20 g Cornstarch", "6 g Gelatin powder, unflavored", "30 ml Water", "1 piece Lime zest, from 1 lime"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Crush the digestive biscuits into fine crumbs using a food processor or by placing them in a sealed bag and smashing with a rolling pin. Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, then mix it with the biscuit crumbs until well combined. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 24 cm pie dish to form the crust. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes until lightly golden, then remove and let it cool completely. In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin powder over 30 ml of cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes. In a saucepan over medium heat, whisk together the cornstarch, honey, and lime juice until smooth. Gently heat this mixture, stirring constantly, until it thickens slightly, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat, add the bloomed gelatin, and stir until fully dissolved. In a large bowl, combine the Greek yogurt and lime zest. Gradually fold in the warm lime mixture until smooth and evenly incorporated. Pour the filling into the cooled crust, spreading it evenly. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until firmly set. Before serving, garnish with additional lime zest if desired.

title: Healthy Lemon Bars with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, whole", "50 g Coconut oil", "30 g Honey", "200 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "4 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Sugar, cane", "40 g Almond flour", "20 g Cornflour, unmodified"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a food processor, pulse the oats and almonds until they form a coarse flour. Add the coconut oil, honey, and 1 tablespoon of water, then process until the mixture comes together like a dough. Press this mixture firmly into the bottom of a 20x20 cm baking dish lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15 minutes until lightly golden. While the crust bakes, whisk together the lemon juice, eggs, sugar, almond flour, and cornflour in a bowl until smooth and slightly thickened. Pour this filling over the hot crust. Return to the oven and bake for another 20-25 minutes, until the top is set and no longer jiggly in the center. Let the bars cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours to firm up. Cut into 9 squares to serve.

title: Healthy Lemon Bars with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oats, rolled, raw", "100 g Almonds, whole, raw", "50 g Dates, dried, without stone", "60 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 piece Lemon, zest from", "3 piece Egg, raw, whole", "80 g Honey, raw", "40 g Coconut oil, raw", "30 g Almond flour", "20 g Cornstarch, modified"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Line a 20x20 cm baking dish with parchment paper. To make the crust, process the oats, almonds, and dates in a food processor until it forms a sticky dough. Press the mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes until lightly golden. While the crust bakes, prepare the filling by whisking together the lemon juice, lemon zest, eggs, honey, melted coconut oil, almond flour, and cornstarch until smooth and well combined. Remove the crust from the oven and pour the filling over it. Return to the oven and bake for another 20-25 minutes, until the filling is set and no longer jiggles in the center. Allow the bars to cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours to firm up. Cut into 9 squares and serve chilled.

title: Healthy Lemon Bars with Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almond flour", "50 g Oat flour", "60 g Coconut oil, melted", "80 g Honey", "2 piece Egg, raw", "200 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "Zest of 2 lemons", "40 g Cornstarch", "25 g Honey, extra", "1 tsp Baking powder"]

Allow to cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours to firm up. Cut into 9 squares and dust with a little powdered sugar if desired before serving.

title: Healthy Lemon Bars with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, whole", "50 g Coconut oil", "30 g Honey", "3 piece Egg, raw", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "100 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 piece Lemon zest, from 1 lemon", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "40 g Honey", "5 g Baking powder"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 20x20 cm baking dish with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the oats, almonds, coconut oil, and 30 g honey until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs and sticks together when pressed. Press this mixture firmly into the bottom of the prepared baking dish to form the crust. Bake the crust for 15 minutes until lightly golden, then remove from the oven and let it cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, lemon zest, whole wheat flour, 40 g honey, and baking powder until smooth and well combined. Pour this filling evenly over the cooled crust. Return the dish to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the filling is set in the center and the top is just starting to turn golden. Allow the lemon bars to cool completely in the dish at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours to firm up. Cut into 9 squares before serving.

title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["100 g Coconut flakes, desiccated", "80 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "2 piece Egg white, raw", "50 g Honey, blossom", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "30 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, melted"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the almonds until finely ground but not turning into almond butter, about 30 seconds. In a large bowl, whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form, which takes about 2-3 minutes with an electric mixer. Gently fold in the ground almonds, coconut flakes, honey, and vanilla extract until the mixture is well combined and holds together when squeezed. Using a tablespoon, scoop out portions of the mixture and shape them into small mounds on the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 2 cm between each. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-18 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the macaroons are firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely on the baking sheet. Once cooled, drizzle with the melted dark chocolate using a spoon. Allow the chocolate to set at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with Oats
ingredients_json: ["100 g Coconut flakes, desiccated", "80 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "2 piece Egg white, raw", "40 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Baking powder"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the oats and almonds until they form a fine meal, being careful not to overprocess into butter. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the coconut flakes and baking powder. In a separate clean bowl, whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gently fold in the honey and vanilla extract. Gradually fold the egg white mixture into the dry ingredients until just combined, ensuring the batter holds together. Using a spoon or cookie scoop, drop tablespoon-sized mounds onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 5 cm apart. Bake for 15-18 minutes or until the edges are golden and the macaroons are firm to the touch. Allow them to cool completely on the baking sheet before serving.

title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with Oats
ingredients_json: ["100 g Coconut flakes, desiccated, unsweetened", "80 g Oats, rolled, dry", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Egg white, raw", "40 g Honey, blossom", "1 g Salt, table", "5 g Coconut oil, virgin"]

In a large bowl, whisk the egg whites with the salt until frothy, then stir in the honey and coconut oil until smooth. Add the dry mixture to the wet ingredients and mix until a sticky dough forms; it should hold together when squeezed. Using a teaspoon, scoop small mounds of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 3 cm apart. Bake for 15-18 minutes until the edges are golden and the macaroons feel firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely on the baking sheet before transferring to a wire rack.

title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with Oats
ingredients_json: ["100 g Coconut flakes, desiccated", "80 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Almonds, ground", "2 piece Egg white, raw", "30 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Baking powder"]

In a separate bowl, mix the coconut flakes, rolled oats, ground almonds, and baking powder. Gradually fold the dry mixture into the egg whites until a thick batter forms; it should hold together when squeezed. Using a tablespoon, scoop portions of the batter onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 3 cm apart, and shape them into small mounds if needed. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-18 minutes, or until the macaroons are golden brown on the edges and firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and let them cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with Oats
ingredients_json: ["100 g Coconut flakes, desiccated", "50 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "2 piece Egg white, raw", "50 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Baking powder"]

Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the coconut flakes and baking powder. Gently fold the egg white mixture into the dry ingredients until just combined, forming a sticky dough. Using a spoon or cookie scoop, drop tablespoon-sized mounds of the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 3 cm apart. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-18 minutes, or until the macaroons are golden brown on the edges and firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely on the baking sheet before serving.

title: Berry Avocado Chocolate Mousse
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, raw, flesh only", "200 g Raspberries, raw", "200 g Blueberries, raw", "40 g Cocoa powder, natural, unsweetened", "100 ml Almond milk, unsweetened", "1 g Stevia extract powder", "5 g Vanilla extract", "20 ml Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits, and scoop out the flesh into a blender or food processor. Add the raspberries, blueberries, cocoa powder, almond milk, stevia extract powder, vanilla extract, and lemon juice. Blend on high speed until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed, which should take about 2-3 minutes. Taste and adjust sweetness if necessary by adding a tiny bit more stevia. Divide the mousse into 4 serving glasses or bowls. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to chill and set. Serve cold, garnished with a few fresh berries if desired.

title: Berry Yogurt Mousse with Chia Seeds
ingredients_json: ["400 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "200 g Raspberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "30 g Chia seeds, dried", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 ml Whipping cream, 35% fat", "20 g Honey", "10 g Gelatin powder", "50 ml Water, cold"]
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin powder over the cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes until it softens and absorbs the liquid. Gently heat the bloomed gelatin in a microwave for 10-15 seconds until it fully dissolves, stirring well; set aside to cool slightly. In a blender or food processor, puree the raspberries and blueberries until smooth. In a large mixing bowl, whisk the plain yogurt with the honey and vanilla extract until creamy. Fold in the chia seeds and let the mixture sit for 10 minutes to thicken slightly as the seeds absorb moisture. Whip the whipping cream in a separate bowl to soft peaks using an electric mixer on medium speed. Gently fold the pureed berries, cooled gelatin, and whipped cream into the yogurt mixture until fully combined and no streaks remain; the mixture should be light and airy. Divide the mousse evenly into 4 serving glasses or ramekins. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until set and chilled. Serve cold, garnished with a few fresh berries if desired.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse with Berries
ingredients_json: ["300 g Avocados, raw, peeled and pitted", "50 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "100 g Honey", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "5 g Vanilla extract", "100 g Raspberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw"]
instructions: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits, scoop out the flesh, and place it in a blender or food processor. Add the cocoa powder, honey, milk, and vanilla extract. Blend on high speed for 2-3 minutes until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Taste and adjust sweetness if desired, but it should be perfectly balanced. Divide the mousse evenly into 4 serving glasses or bowls. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set and chill. Before serving, top each mousse with 25 g of raspberries and 25 g of blueberries. Serve cold and enjoy the rich, velvety texture.

title: Berry Chia Yogurt Mousse with Avocado Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 g Avocado, raw, peeled", "150 g Raspberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "30 g Chia seeds", "50 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "20 g Honey", "10 g Mint leaves, fresh, chopped", "1 g Vanilla extract"]
instructions: In a blender, combine the yogurt, avocado, lemon juice, honey, and vanilla extract. Blend on high speed until completely smooth and creamy, about 1-2 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl. Gently fold in the chia seeds, ensuring they are evenly distributed, then let it sit for 10 minutes to thicken slightly. In a separate bowl, mash half of the raspberries and blueberries with a fork until juicy but still chunky, then fold them into the yogurt mixture along with the remaining whole berries and chopped mint. Whip the mixture lightly with a hand mixer on low speed for 1 minute to incorporate air and achieve a fluffy mousse texture. Spoon the mousse into 4 serving glasses or bowls. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. Serve chilled, garnished with a few extra berries if desired.

title: Berry Chia Yogurt Mousse
ingredients_json: ["400 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g Mixed berries, frozen, thawed", "50 g Chia seeds", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Honey", "5 g Gelatine powder", "50 ml Water, cold"]
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatine powder over the cold water and let it bloom for 5 minutes until it softens and absorbs the liquid. Gently heat the bloomed gelatine in a microwave for 10-15 seconds on low power until it fully dissolves, stirring once; do not boil. In a blender, combine the yogurt, thawed mixed berries, chia seeds, milk, and honey. Blend on high speed for 1-2 minutes until smooth and creamy. With the blender running on low, slowly pour in the dissolved gelatine and blend for another 30 seconds to incorporate evenly. Pour the mixture into 4 individual serving glasses or ramekins. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until set and mousse-like in texture; the top should jiggle slightly but hold its shape. Serve chilled, optionally garnished with fresh berries.

title: Healthy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Flour, wheat, wholemeal", "80 g Sugar, brown", "50 g Raisins, seedless", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "3 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "5 ml Milk, semi-skimmed"]

In a separate bowl, whisk together the oats, wholemeal flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt. Gradually stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, then fold in the raisins and milk to form a dough. Drop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 5 cm apart. Gently flatten each mound with your fingers. Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, until the edges are golden brown but the centers are still soft. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies with Cinnamon and Nuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g Rolled oats", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "60 g Almonds, chopped", "80 g Raisins", "50 g Coconut oil", "60 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Apple, grated", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt", "5 ml Vanilla extract"]

In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, chopped almonds, raisins, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted coconut oil, honey, egg, grated apple, and vanilla extract until smooth. Combine the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms; do not overmix. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 5 cm apart, and gently flatten each with your fingers. Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden and the centers are set. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Flour, wheat, wholemeal", "50 g Sugar, brown", "40 g Margarine, 60-80% fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Raisins, seedless", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Baking powder", "1 g Salt, table", "20 ml Milk, skimmed"]
