Pour the filling into the pre-baked crust. Bake at 180°C for 45-50 minutes, until the center is just set but still slightly jiggly. Turn off the oven and crack the door open, letting the pie cool inside for 1 hour to prevent cracking. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Healthy Oat and Almond Rhubarb Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rhubarb, raw, chopped", "100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, whole, ground", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Apple, raw, grated", "30 g Sunflower oil", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "3 g Ginger, ground", "2 g Salt", "15 g Cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, ground almonds, whole wheat flour, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and cornstarch, mixing them thoroughly until evenly distributed. In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, honey, sunflower oil, and grated apple to form a wet mixture. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients along with the chopped rhubarb until everything is well combined into a thick batter. Grease a 22 cm pie dish lightly with a bit of oil, then spread the batter evenly into the dish, smoothing the top with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Remove from the oven and allow the pie to cool on a wire rack for at least 20 minutes before slicing to let it set properly.

title: Healthy Rhubarb Pie with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Flour, wheat, plain", "100 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "75 g Margarine, 60-80% fat", "30 ml Water, tap", "600 g Rhubarb, raw, chopped", "80 g Honey", "20 g Cornstarch, unmodified", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a food processor, pulse together the flour, oats, and almonds until finely ground. Add the margarine and pulse until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add the water while pulsing until the dough just comes together. Press the dough evenly into a 24 cm pie dish, covering the bottom and sides. Prick the base with a fork and bake for 10 minutes until lightly set. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss the chopped rhubarb with honey, cornstarch, and cinnamon until well coated. Spoon the filling into the pre-baked crust. Brush the edges of the crust with beaten egg for shine. Bake the pie for 35-40 minutes, until the filling is bubbly and the crust is golden. Allow to cool for at least 1 hour before serving to let the filling set.

title: Healthy Oat and Almond Rhubarb Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "30 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "500 g Rhubarb, raw", "50 g Sugar, cane", "20 g Cornstarch", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 pinch Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. To make the crust, process the oats and almonds in a food processor until finely ground. Add the butter, honey, egg, and a pinch of salt, then pulse until the mixture comes together like dough. Press this mixture firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 24 cm pie dish to form the crust. Bake the crust for 10 minutes until lightly set, then remove from the oven and let it cool slightly. While the crust bakes, prepare the filling by washing and chopping the rhubarb into 1 cm pieces. In a bowl, toss the rhubarb with sugar, cornstarch, and cinnamon until evenly coated. Spoon the filling into the pre-baked crust, spreading it evenly. Return the pie to the oven and bake for 35-40 minutes, until the filling is bubbling and the crust is golden brown. Check after 30 minutes and cover the edges with foil if they brown too quickly. Let the pie cool completely on a wire rack before slicing to allow the filling to set.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Rhubarb Pie with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Flour, wheat, whole grain", "100 g Oats, rolled", "80 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "600 g Rhubarb, raw", "50 g Sugar, cane", "20 g Cornstarch, unmodified", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 tsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a food processor, pulse together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, unsalted butter, honey, and egg until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs and starts to come together. Press two-thirds of this dough evenly into the bottom and up the sides of a 24 cm pie dish to form the crust. Chill the remaining dough in the fridge. Chop the rhubarb into 1 cm pieces and toss it in a bowl with cane sugar, cornstarch, ground cinnamon, and lemon juice until well coated. Let the filling sit for 10 minutes to release juices. Pour the filling into the prepared crust. Roll out the remaining dough on a lightly floured surface and cut into strips to create a lattice top, or simply cover the pie and crimp the edges. Place the pie on a baking sheet and bake for 45-50 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Check after 30 minutes and cover the edges with foil if they brown too quickly. Allow the pie to cool completely on a wire rack before slicing to set the filling.

title: Creamy Coconut Rice Pudding with Cinnamon and Dates
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice, pudding, uncooked", "1 l Milk, semi-skimmed", "200 ml Coconut milk, canned", "50 g Dates, dried, chopped", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 pinch Salt, table"]
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the rice, semi-skimmed milk, coconut milk, chopped dates, ground cinnamon, and salt. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring frequently to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and let it simmer uncovered for 35-40 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. The pudding is ready when the rice is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid, achieving a creamy consistency. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly before serving warm, or chill in the refrigerator for a cold dessert.

title: Creamy Coconut Rice Pudding with Cinnamon and Chia Seeds
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice, pudding, dry", "1 l Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "400 ml Coconut milk, canned", "50 g Chia seeds", "40 g Honey", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 g Raisins"]
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the rice, semi-skimmed milk, and coconut milk. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the rice is tender and the mixture has thickened to a creamy consistency. Stir in the chia seeds, honey, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and raisins. Continue to cook on low heat for another 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the chia seeds soften and the pudding reaches your desired thickness. Remove from heat and let it stand for 10 minutes to thicken further. Serve warm or chilled, sprinkled with a little extra cinnamon if desired.

title: Creamy Coconut Rice Pudding with Cinnamon and Cardamom
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice, white, long-grain, uncooked", "1 l Milk, semi-skimmed", "200 ml Coconut milk, canned", "50 g Raisins, seedless", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Cardamom, ground", "40 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain well. In a large saucepan, combine the rice, milk, coconut milk, raisins, cinnamon, cardamom, honey, vanilla extract, and salt. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 35-40 minutes, stirring every 5-10 minutes. The rice should be tender and the pudding thick and creamy; if it's too thick, stir in a splash of milk. Remove from heat and let it stand covered for 10 minutes before serving warm, optionally sprinkled with extra cinnamon.

title: Coconut Rice Pudding with Cinnamon and Cardamom
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice, pudding, uncooked", "800 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "200 ml Coconut milk, canned", "40 g Sugar, white", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Cardamom, ground", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Raisins", "20 g Almonds, flaked"]
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the rice, semi-skimmed milk, coconut milk, sugar, cinnamon, and cardamom. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring frequently to prevent the rice from sticking. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 35-40 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the rice is tender and the pudding has thickened to a creamy consistency. The milk should be mostly absorbed, leaving a soft, velvety texture. Stir in the vanilla extract and raisins during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly for 10 minutes. Toast the flaked almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden, stirring constantly. Spoon the warm rice pudding into serving bowls and sprinkle with the toasted almonds. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Creamy Coconut Rice Pudding with Cinnamon and Chia Seeds
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice, white, long-grain, uncooked", "1 l Milk, semi-skimmed", "200 ml Coconut milk, canned", "50 g Chia seeds", "40 g Honey", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 g Raisins", "500 ml Water"]
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the rice and water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 10 minutes until the rice is partially tender and most of the water is absorbed. Stir in the semi-skimmed milk, coconut milk, chia seeds, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Bring the mixture back to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soft and the pudding has thickened to a creamy consistency. In the last 5 minutes, add the raisins and stir until plump. Remove from heat and let it stand for 10 minutes to thicken further. Serve warm or chilled, sprinkled with a little extra cinnamon if desired.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Almond Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_json: ["150 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almond flour", "80 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Coconut oil", "60 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "80 g Raisins, seedless", "50 g Dates, dried, chopped", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 g Almond butter"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the oats, almond flour, whole wheat flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the coconut oil with the honey until smooth, then beat in the egg. Combine the wet and dry ingredients, stirring until a dough forms, then fold in the raisins and chopped dates. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheets, flatten slightly, and bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden. Let the cookies cool completely on the sheets. For the filling, mix the Greek yogurt and almond butter until creamy. Spread about 1 teaspoon of filling on the flat side of half the cookies, then top with the remaining cookies to form sandwiches. Store in an airtight container.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Almond Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_json: ["100 g Oats, rolled, raw", "100 g Flour, wheat, all-purpose", "50 g Almonds, whole, raw", "75 g Raisins, seedless", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw, whole", "5 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Baking powder", "1 g Salt, table", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and honey until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes with an electric mixer. Beat in the egg until fully combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until just combined. Fold in the chopped almonds and raisins. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them 5 cm apart, and flatten slightly. Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden brown. Let the cookies cool completely on the sheets. Once cooled, spread about 1 teaspoon of Greek yogurt on the flat side of half the cookies and top with another cookie to form sandwiches. Store in an airtight container.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Almond Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_json: ["100 g Oats, rolled", "80 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almonds, ground", "40 g Raisins, seedless", "1 piece Egg, raw", "40 g Honey", "30 g Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.25 tsp Baking powder", "0.25 tsp Salt", "50 g Greek yogurt, low-fat, plain"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the oats, whole wheat flour, ground almonds, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, honey, and olive oil until well combined. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry mixture along with the raisins until a dough forms. If the dough is too sticky, add a tiny bit more flour. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the baking sheet, flatten slightly with your fingers, and bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden. Let the cookies cool completely on a wire rack. Once cooled, spread about 1 teaspoon of Greek yogurt on the flat side of half the cookies, then top each with another cookie to make sandwiches. Store in an airtight container.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Almond Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_json: ["100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almonds, ground", "50 g Raisins", "40 g Coconut oil", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "20 g Honey", "5 g Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the oats, whole wheat flour, ground almonds, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, then add the coconut oil, honey, and 50 g Greek yogurt until smooth. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients along with the raisins until a dough forms. Drop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the baking sheet, spacing them 5 cm apart, and flatten slightly with your fingers. Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden and the centers are set. Let the cookies cool completely on a wire rack. Meanwhile, prepare the filling by mixing 100 g Greek yogurt, 20 g honey, and vanilla extract until smooth. Once cookies are cool, spread about 1 teaspoon of filling on the flat side of half the cookies, then top with the remaining cookies to form sandwiches. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Almond Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_json: ["100 g Oats, rolled", "80 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almonds, ground", "40 g Raisins, seedless", "1 piece Egg, raw", "30 g Honey", "20 g Coconut oil", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.25 tsp Baking powder", "1 g Salt", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 g Cream cheese, light"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the oats, whole wheat flour, ground almonds, raisins, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt. In a separate small bowl, whisk the egg, honey, and melted coconut oil until smooth, then stir this wet mixture into the dry ingredients to form a dough. Roll the dough into 24 small balls, about 15g each, flatten them slightly with your palms, and place them on the baking sheet spaced apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden and the cookies are firm. Let them cool completely on a wire rack. Meanwhile, stir together the Greek yogurt and cream cheese until smooth and creamy. Once cookies are cool, spread about 5g of the yogurt cream on the flat side of 12 cookies, then top each with another cookie to make 12 sandwich cookies. Chill in the fridge for 15 minutes to set before serving.

title: Healthy Oat and Almond Shortbread with Citrus Zest
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, ground", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "10 g Orange zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 20x20 cm baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and honey until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes with an electric mixer. Beat in the egg and orange zest until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, oats, ground almonds, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until a dough forms; it should be crumbly but hold together when pressed. Press the dough evenly into the prepared tray, using the back of a spoon to smooth the top. Bake for 20-25 minutes until the edges are golden brown and the center is firm. Allow to cool completely in the tray before cutting into 16 squares. Store in an airtight container.

title: Lemon Oat Shortbread with Almonds
ingredients_json: ["200 g Flour, wheat, plain", "50 g Oats, rolled", "75 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "60 g Sugar, granulated", "1 tbsp Lemon zest", "30 ml Lemon juice", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 20x20 cm baking tray with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the almonds until finely chopped but not powdery. In a large bowl, cream the softened butter and sugar together with a wooden spoon until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until well combined. Mix in the flour, oats, chopped almonds, and salt to form a firm dough; it should hold together when pressed. Press the dough evenly into the prepared tray, about 1 cm thick, and prick the surface all over with a fork. Bake for 25-30 minutes until the edges are golden brown and the center is firm. Remove from the oven and allow to cool completely in the tray before cutting into 16 squares.

title: Lemon Almond Oat Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["200 g Flour, wheat, plain", "100 g Oats, rolled", "80 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "50 g Almonds, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 20x20 cm baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, rub the cold butter into the flour, oats, ground almonds, and salt until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Stir in the honey, finely grated zest of the lemon, and 15 ml of its juice to form a firm dough; if it's too dry, add a tiny bit more juice but keep it crumbly. Press the dough evenly into the prepared tray, about 1 cm thick, and prick all over with a fork. Bake for 25-30 minutes until lightly golden around the edges and firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and cool in the tray for 10 minutes, then cut into 16 squares while still warm. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Lemon Oat Shortbread with Almonds
ingredients_json: ["250 g Flour, wheat, plain", "100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "80 g Sugar, cane", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "1 g Salt, table", "50 g Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C fan or 180°C conventional. Line a 20x20 cm square baking tin with parchment paper. In a large bowl, rub the cold butter into the flour, oats, sugar, salt, and finely chopped almonds until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Grate in the lemon zest and stir in 2 tablespoons of lemon juice along with the honey to form a firm dough; if too dry, add 1-2 teaspoons of water. Press the dough evenly into the prepared tin, about 1 cm thick. Prick the surface all over with a fork. Bake for 30-35 minutes until lightly golden around the edges and firm to the touch. Allow to cool completely in the tin, then cut into 16 squares. Store in an airtight container.

title: Lemon Oat Shortbread with Almonds
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "150 g Butter, unsalted", "80 g Honey", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a 20x20 cm baking tray with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the oats and almonds until they form a coarse flour. In a large bowl, cream the softened butter with the honey using a wooden spoon or mixer until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Grate in the lemon zest and squeeze in 2 tablespoons of juice, mixing well. Add the oat-almond flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt, then stir until a dough forms; it should be crumbly but hold together when pressed. Press the dough evenly into the prepared tray, about 1 cm thick. Prick the surface all over with a fork. Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown around the edges and firm to the touch. Allow to cool completely in the tray before cutting into 16 squares.

title: Strawberry Shortcakes with Whole Wheat Biscuits and Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "25 g Cane sugar", "50 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "150 ml Buttermilk, low-fat", "300 g Strawberries, fresh", "50 g Cane sugar", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and 25 g cane sugar. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the flour mixture using your fingertips or a pastry cutter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized butter pieces remaining. Make a well in the center and pour in the buttermilk. Stir gently with a fork until the dough just comes together, being careful not to overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, pat it into a 2 cm thick rectangle, and fold it over itself twice to create layers. Pat it out again to 2 cm thick and cut into 6 rounds using a 6 cm cutter. Place the shortcakes on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and risen. Let them cool on a wire rack. Meanwhile, hull and slice the strawberries, toss them with 50 g cane sugar in a bowl, and let them macerate for 15 minutes to release their juices. In a separate bowl, stir the yogurt with vanilla extract until smooth. To serve, split each shortcake in half horizontally, layer the bottom half with yogurt cream and macerated strawberries, then top with the other half.

title: Strawberry Shortcakes with Whole Wheat Biscuits and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "100 g Wheat flour, white, plain", "2 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Cane sugar", "60 g Butter, unsalted", "200 ml Buttermilk, low-fat", "400 g Strawberries, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "2 tbsp Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, white flour, baking powder, salt, and 1 tablespoon of the cane sugar. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the buttermilk just until the dough comes together; do not overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, pat it into a 2 cm thick round, and cut out 6 biscuits using a 6 cm round cutter. Place the biscuits on a parchment-lined baking sheet and sprinkle the tops with the remaining 1 tablespoon of cane sugar. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and risen. Let cool slightly. Meanwhile, hull and slice the strawberries, then toss them with 1 tablespoon of honey. Split each warm biscuit in half, layer the bottom half with a dollop of yogurt, pile on the strawberries, drizzle with the remaining honey, and top with the other biscuit half. Serve immediately.

title: Strawberry Shortcakes with Whole Wheat Biscuits and Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["150 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "100 g Wheat flour, white, plain", "1.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "0.25 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Cane sugar", "60 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "180 ml Buttermilk, low-fat", "300 g Strawberries, raw", "2 tbsp Honey", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, white flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and 1 tablespoon of the cane sugar. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Stir in the buttermilk just until the dough comes together; do not overmix. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface, pat it into a 2 cm thick round, and cut out 6 biscuits using a 6 cm round cutter. Place the biscuits on a parchment-lined baking sheet, brush the tops with a little buttermilk, and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of cane sugar. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and risen. Let cool on a wire rack. Meanwhile, hull and slice the strawberries, then toss them with the honey in a bowl and let macerate for 15 minutes. In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt and vanilla extract to make the cream. To serve, split the warm biscuits in half, layer the bottom half with yogurt cream and macerated strawberries, then top with the other half.

title: Strawberry Shortcakes with Whole Wheat Biscuits and Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["200 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "50 g Oats, rolled", "2 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Cane sugar", "80 g Butter, unsalted", "1 dl Milk, low-fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "400 g Strawberries, raw", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, salt, and 1 tablespoon of the cane sugar. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Beat the egg and milk together in a small bowl, then stir into the dry ingredients just until a soft dough forms; do not overmix. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface, pat it into a 2 cm thick round, and cut out 6 biscuits using a 6 cm round cutter. Place them on the prepared baking sheet and sprinkle the remaining tablespoon of sugar on top. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and risen. Let cool on a wire rack. Meanwhile, hull and slice the strawberries, tossing them with any juices. In a bowl, stir together the yogurt and vanilla extract for the cream. To serve, split the warm biscuits in half, layer the bottom half with yogurt cream and strawberries, then top with the other half and more strawberries.

title: Healthy Oat Flour Snickerdoodles with Almond Butter
ingredients_json: ["225 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats, finely ground", "1 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Salt", "2 tsp Ground cinnamon", "50 g Almond butter, smooth", "75 g Coconut oil, melted", "150 g Coconut sugar", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Coconut sugar, for rolling", "2 tsp Ground cinnamon, for rolling"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, ground oats, baking soda, salt, and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon. In a large bowl, beat the almond butter, melted coconut oil, and 150 grams of coconut sugar until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes. Add the egg and vanilla extract, beating until fully combined. Gradually stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until a dough forms; do not overmix. In a small bowl, mix the 50 grams of coconut sugar with 2 teaspoons of cinnamon. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough, roll them into balls, then coat each ball thoroughly in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. Place the balls on the prepared baking sheets, spacing them 5 cm apart, and gently flatten slightly with your palm. Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the edges are set but the centers are still soft. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Pumpkin Spice Cakes with Oats and Ginger
ingredients_json: ["200 g Pumpkin puree, cooked", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Oats, rolled, raw", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "2 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 g Honey, raw", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Ginger, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with 12 paper liners. In a large bowl, blend the pumpkin puree, eggs, yogurt, honey, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, oats, ground almonds, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, baking powder, and baking soda. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Divide the batter evenly among the 12 muffin liners, filling each about three-quarters full. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cake comes out clean. Allow the cakes to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Spiced Carrot and Apple Spice Cakes
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "150 g Carrot, grated", "100 g Apple, grated", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 g Honey", "2 piece Egg, raw", "50 ml Sunflower oil", "5 g Baking powder", "3 g Baking soda", "2 g Ground cinnamon", "1 g Ground ginger", "1 g Ground nutmeg", "1 g Salt", "50 ml Skim milk"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with 12 paper liners. Pour the filling into the pre-baked crust and smooth the top. Bake for 45-50 minutes at 180°C until the center is set but slightly jiggles and a knife inserted comes out clean. Allow the pie to cool completely at room temperature before chilling in the fridge for at least 2 hours to firm up.

title: Healthy Spiced Sweet Potato Pie
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sweet potato, raw", "2 piece Egg, raw", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g Oats, rolled", "30 g Almonds, whole", "50 g Maple syrup", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Nutmeg, ground", "2 g Ginger, ground", "1 g Salt, table", "10 ml Lemon juice", "5 g Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Pierce the sweet potatoes several times with a fork and bake them directly on the oven rack for 45-50 minutes until they are very soft when pierced with a knife. Remove from the oven, let them cool slightly, then cut open and scoop out the flesh, discarding the skins. You should have about 400 g of mashed sweet potato. In a food processor, pulse the oats and almonds together until they form a fine crumb resembling flour. Press this mixture evenly into the bottom and sides of a 23 cm pie dish to form the crust, using the back of a spoon to compact it. Bake the crust in the preheated oven for 10 minutes until lightly golden, then remove and set aside. In a large bowl, whisk together the mashed sweet potato, eggs, milk, maple syrup, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, salt, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy with no lumps. Pour this filling into the pre-baked crust, smoothing the top with a spatula. Bake the pie at 180°C for 40-45 minutes, until the center is set but still slightly jiggly and a knife inserted near the edge comes out clean. Turn off the oven and let the pie cool inside with the door ajar for 1 hour to prevent cracking. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before slicing to serve.

title: Healthy Yogurt Berry Tiramisu
ingredients_json: ["200 g Ladyfingers, plain", "200 ml Skim milk", "2 tbsp Coffee, instant, dissolved in 100 ml hot water", "400 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "200 g Ricotta cheese, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "200 g Raspberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "20 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix the instant coffee with 100 ml hot water and let it cool slightly. Pour the skim milk into another shallow bowl. Quickly dip each ladyfinger into the coffee mixture, then into the skim milk, and arrange half of them in an 20x25 cm dish. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the low-fat yogurt, low-fat ricotta cheese, honey, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy. Spread half of this mixture over the ladyfingers. Scatter half of the raspberries and blueberries evenly on top. Repeat with the remaining dipped ladyfingers, yogurt mixture, and berries. Dust the top generously with cocoa powder using a fine sieve. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld and the dessert to set firmly.

title: Healthy Almond Date Toffee Bites
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, dried, pitted", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Oats, rolled", "30 g Coconut oil", "20 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "5 g Sea salt", "10 ml Water"]
instructions: Line a small baking tray with parchment paper and set aside. Place the pitted dates and water in a food processor and blend until it forms a smooth sticky paste. Toast the almonds and oats in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until fragrant and golden, stirring frequently to prevent burning, then let them cool slightly. Chop the toasted almonds and oats roughly. In a saucepan, gently melt the coconut oil over low heat. Add the date paste, cocoa powder, and sea salt to the melted oil, stirring continuously for 2-3 minutes until it thickens into a fudge-like toffee consistency and starts to pull away from the sides. Remove from heat and quickly mix in the chopped almonds and oats until evenly distributed. Press the warm mixture firmly into the prepared tray to about 1 cm thickness. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm. Cut into 16 small bite-sized squares and store in an airtight container in the fridge.

title: Healthy Date and Almond Toffee Bites
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, dried, pitted", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Oats, rolled", "30 g Coconut oil", "2 tsp Honey", "1 tsp Sea salt flakes", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Line a small baking tray with parchment paper. Place the pitted dates in a food processor and blend until they form a smooth paste, scraping down the sides as needed. In a dry skillet over medium heat, toast the almonds and oats for 4-5 minutes until fragrant and golden, stirring frequently to prevent burning, then let them cool slightly. In a saucepan, melt the coconut oil over low heat, then stir in the date paste, honey, and vanilla extract. Cook the mixture gently for 5 minutes, stirring constantly until it thickens and pulls away from the sides slightly. Remove from heat, fold in the toasted almonds, oats, and half of the sea salt flakes. Spread the mixture evenly onto the prepared tray, about 1 cm thick. Sprinkle the remaining sea salt over the top and press lightly. Refrigerate for 2 hours until firm, then break into 12 bite-sized pieces.

title: Healthy Date and Nut Toffee Bites
ingredients_json: ["200 g Medjool dates, pitted", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Cashew nuts, raw", "30 g Coconut oil", "1 tsp Sea salt flakes", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "20 g Sesame seeds"]
instructions: Pit the dates if not already pitted and place them in a food processor. Add the almonds, cashew nuts, coconut oil, vanilla extract, and half of the sea salt. Process on high speed until the mixture comes together into a sticky dough-like consistency, about 2-3 minutes, scraping down the sides as needed. Line a small baking tray (about 15x15 cm) with parchment paper. Press the mixture firmly and evenly into the tray, about 1 cm thick. Sprinkle the sesame seeds and remaining sea salt evenly over the top, pressing lightly to adhere. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm. Lift out using the parchment paper and cut into 16 small bite-sized pieces. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Healthy Nutty Date Toffee Bites
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, dried, pitted", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Cashew nuts, roasted", "30 g Coconut oil", "20 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "5 g Sea salt", "10 g Sesame seeds"]
instructions: Pit the dates if necessary and process them in a food processor until they form a thick, sticky paste. Add the almonds and cashew nuts to the food processor and pulse until they are coarsely chopped and well incorporated into the date paste. In a small saucepan, gently melt the coconut oil over low heat until fully liquid. Mix the melted coconut oil, cocoa powder, and sea salt into the date-nut mixture until everything is evenly combined and has a fudge-like consistency. Line a small baking tray with parchment paper and spread the mixture evenly into it, about 1 cm thick. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and press them gently into the surface. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until firm. Once set, cut into 12 small bite-sized squares. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Healthy Date and Almond Toffee Bites
ingredients_json: ["200 g Medjool dates, pitted", "100 g Almonds, whole, raw", "50 g Coconut oil", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 tsp Sea salt flakes", "50 g Oats, rolled", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Line a small baking tray with parchment paper and set aside. In a food processor, blend the pitted Medjool dates, coconut oil, cocoa powder, oats, vanilla extract, and half of the sea salt until you get a smooth, sticky dough that comes together when pressed. Roughly chop half of the almonds and fold them into the dough along with the remaining whole almonds. Press the mixture firmly and evenly into the prepared tray, about 1 cm thick. Sprinkle the remaining sea salt flakes evenly over the top and gently press them in. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until firm. Cut into 16 small bite-sized squares and store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Lemon Almond Yogurt Torte with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "100 g Honey", "3 piece Egg, raw", "1 piece Lemon, juice and zest", "50 g Olive oil", "1 tsp Baking powder", "100 g Raspberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "20 g Almonds, flaked"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20 cm springform pan with a little olive oil, then line the bottom with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the 3 eggs, 100 g honey, juice and zest of 1 lemon, 150 g Greek yogurt, and 50 g olive oil until smooth and well combined. In a separate bowl, combine 200 g almond flour, 100 g whole wheat flour, and 1 tsp baking powder. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden. Allow the torte to cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Once cooled, top with 100 g fresh raspberries, 100 g fresh blueberries, and scatter 20 g flaked almonds over the top. Slice and serve at room temperature.

title: Lemon Almond Yogurt Torte with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Honey", "50 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Lemon zest", "1 tsp Baking powder", "50 g Raspberries, raw", "50 g Blueberries, raw", "20 g Almonds, flaked"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20 cm springform pan lightly with oil. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the almond flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder until evenly combined. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the honey, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth and creamy. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the raspberries and blueberries. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and sprinkle the flaked almonds on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the torte to cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Zesty Lemon Almond Torte with Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "4 pieces Egg, raw", "150 g Honey", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "50 g Olive oil", "1 tsp Baking powder", "50 g Powdered sugar, for glaze", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat, for glaze"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 22 cm springform pan with a little olive oil, then line the bottom with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse the blanched almonds until finely ground but not oily, about 30 seconds. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and honey until pale and fluffy, which takes about 3-4 minutes with an electric mixer. Grate the zest from the lemon and squeeze out 3 tbsp of juice, then add both to the egg mixture along with the Greek yogurt and olive oil, mixing until smooth. Fold in the ground almonds, whole wheat flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt until just combined, avoiding overmixing. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top is golden. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the glaze, whisk 50 g powdered sugar with 50 g Greek yogurt and 1 tbsp lemon juice until smooth and drizzle over the cooled torte. Slice and serve at room temperature.

title: Almond Carrot Torte with Yogurt Frosting
ingredients_json: ["200 g Carrots, raw, grated", "150 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "3 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 g Honey", "50 g Raisins, seedless", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Ginger, ground", "1 pinch Salt", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat (for frosting)", "20 g Honey (for frosting)", "1 tsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 20 cm springform pan, lining the bottom with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the 3 eggs, 80 g honey, 100 g yogurt, cinnamon, ginger, and salt until smooth and creamy. Stir in the grated carrots, raisins, almond flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder until just combined, avoiding overmixing. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake in the center of the oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top is golden. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the frosting, mix 200 g yogurt, 20 g honey, and lemon juice until smooth, then spread over the cooled torte. Chill in the fridge for 30 minutes before serving to set the frosting.

title: Lemon Almond Yogurt Torte with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 g Honey", "3 pieces Egg, raw", "1 piece Lemon, juice and zest", "50 g Olive oil", "100 g Raspberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 22 cm springform pan, lining the bottom with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the almond flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt until well combined. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the honey, olive oil, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth and creamy. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, stirring gently until just combined and no dry pockets remain. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the torte to cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Once cooled, top with fresh raspberries and blueberries just before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles with Almonds and Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, raw", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "50 g Almonds, blanched, chopped", "20 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "15 g Honey", "5 g Orange zest", "2 g Sea salt"]
instructions: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a food processor. Add the honey, orange zest, and sea salt, then process until smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water, stirring occasionally until fully melted and glossy. With the food processor running on low, slowly pour in the melted chocolate and blend until fully incorporated and the mixture is uniform. Transfer the mixture to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour until firm enough to handle. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Scoop out tablespoon-sized portions of the chilled mixture, roll them into smooth balls between your palms, and place them on the prepared sheet. Refrigerate the balls for another 30 minutes to set. Spread the chopped almonds and cocoa powder on separate small plates. Roll half of the truffles in the chopped almonds and the other half in the cocoa powder to coat evenly. Return all truffles to the baking sheet and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to meld.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Date Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, dried, deglet noor, pitted", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "40 g Cocoa powder, natural", "25 g Coconut flakes, desiccated", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Place the pitted dates in a food processor and blend until they form a thick paste, scraping down the sides as needed. Add the almonds, cocoa powder, coconut flakes, and salt to the processor. Pulse until the mixture comes together into a sticky dough that holds its shape when pressed, about 1-2 minutes; do not over-process or it will become too oily. Using a small spoon or your hands, scoop out portions about the size of a walnut and roll them into smooth balls. Place the truffles on a parchment-lined tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm up. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Date Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, dried, pitted", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 g Salt, table", "20 g Coconut flakes, desiccated, unsweetened"]
instructions: Place the pitted dates in a food processor and pulse until they form a thick paste. Add the whole blanched almonds, unsweetened cocoa powder, and table salt to the processor. Process everything together for 1-2 minutes until the mixture is smooth and the almonds are finely ground, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed. The dough should hold together when pinched. Using a teaspoon, scoop out small portions of the mixture and roll them into 20 even balls between your palms. Spread the desiccated coconut flakes on a plate and gently roll each truffle in the coconut to coat. Refrigerate the truffles on a parchment-lined tray for at least 1 hour to firm up before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Date Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, dried, pitted", "100 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "50 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "30 g Coconut flakes, desiccated", "2 g Sea salt", "20 ml Water"]
instructions: Place the pitted dates, almonds, cocoa powder, coconut flakes, sea salt, and water in a food processor. Process on high speed for 2-3 minutes until the mixture comes together into a sticky dough, scraping down the sides as needed. If the mixture is too dry, add 1-2 teaspoons more water. Using a small spoon or your hands, scoop out portions about the size of a walnut and roll them into smooth balls. Place the truffles on a parchment-lined tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm up. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to one week.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles with Almonds
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, raw, peeled", "100 g Dates, dried, chopped", "40 g Cocoa powder, natural", "50 g Almonds, whole, blanched", "1 g Sea salt", "5 ml Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Cut the avocado into chunks and place it in a food processor along with the chopped dates, cocoa powder, sea salt, and vanilla extract. Process the mixture on high speed for about 2 minutes until it becomes a smooth, thick paste, scraping down the sides as needed to ensure even blending. Roughly chop the almonds and stir half of them into the chocolate mixture by hand for added texture. Using a small spoon or melon baller, scoop out portions of the mixture and roll them into 20 even balls, about 15 grams each, between your palms; the mixture will be sticky, so slightly wet your hands if necessary. Roll each ball in the remaining chopped almonds to coat evenly. Place the truffles on a parchment-lined tray and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to firm up. Serve chilled for the best texture.

title: Healthy Pineapple Upside-Down Cake with Oats and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["20 g Butter, salted, unsalted", "50 g Honey", "200 g Pineapple, raw, flesh only", "150 g Flour, wheat, bread", "100 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Almonds, blanched, chopped", "2 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 piece Egg, raw, whole, raw", "2 dl Milk, low fat, 1-1.5% fat", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease a 20 cm round cake pan with 5 g of the butter. Melt the remaining 15 g butter with the honey in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring until combined, then pour it evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan. Arrange the pineapple slices in a single layer over the honey-butter mixture, cutting them to fit if necessary. In a large bowl, mix together the flour, oats, chopped almonds, baking powder, and cinnamon. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, milk, yogurt, and vanilla extract until smooth. Gradually stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Pour the batter evenly over the pineapple layer. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then carefully invert it onto a serving plate to reveal the pineapple topping. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake with Whole Wheat and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["30 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Brown sugar", "4 slices Pineapple, fresh, drained (about 200 g)", "12 pieces Cherries, sweet, fresh, pitted", "150 g Flour, wheat, whole grain", "50 g Almonds, ground", "8 g Baking powder", "1 g Salt", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 ml Vegetable oil, rapeseed", "100 g Honey", "5 ml Lemon juice", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease an 20 cm round cake pan with a little butter. Melt the 30 g butter in a small saucepan over low heat, stir in the brown sugar until dissolved, then pour this mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan. Arrange the pineapple slices in a single layer over the sugar mixture, placing a cherry in the center of each slice. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, ground almonds, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the yogurt, vegetable oil, honey, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Pour the batter evenly over the pineapple and cherries in the pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then carefully invert it onto a serving plate to reveal the pineapple topping. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Healthy Oatmeal Banana Whoopie Pies with Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g Rolled oats", "2 g Baking powder", "3 g Baking soda", "2 g Ground cinnamon", "1 g Salt", "200 g Banana, mashed", "100 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "80 ml Honey", "60 ml Vegetable oil", "2 piece Egg, raw", "10 ml Vanilla extract", "300 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "5 g Vanilla extract", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, mash the bananas until smooth, then mix in the 100 g Greek yogurt, 80 ml honey, vegetable oil, eggs, and 10 ml vanilla extract until well combined. Gradually stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just mixed; fold in the chopped walnuts. Do not overmix. Drop tablespoon-sized mounds of batter onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them 5 cm apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let the cookies cool on the sheets for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the filling, mix together the 300 g Greek yogurt, 50 g honey, and 5 ml vanilla extract until smooth and spreadable. Once the whoopie pie cakes are fully cooled, spread a generous tablespoon of filling on the flat side of half the cakes. Top with the remaining cakes, pressing gently to adhere. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Healthy Oatmeal Banana Whoopie Pies with Yogurt Filling

title: Healthy Oatmeal Banana Whoopie Pies with Yogurt Filling
